jobs.title: Data Analist E-commerce
jobs.description:
Als Data Analist e-commerce ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol.

Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk. 

Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact.

In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes.

Jouw taken

  • Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns;

  • Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance;

  • Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen;

  • Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken;

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten;

  • Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen.


  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics;

  • Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen;

  • Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren;

  • Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert;

  • Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré;

  • Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré;

  • Je woont in Nederland.

Over My Jewellery

My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken!

jobs.title: Data & Insights Analyst
jobs.description:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij Strategy & Portfolio Management verbind je strategie, prioriteiten en resultaat. Samen met collega’s in strategie, performance, programma management help je ExCo en de domeinen om onderbouwde keuzes te maken en gericht bij te sturen. Je bouwt mee aan een team waarin samenwerking, een scherpe inhoudelijke blik en eigenaarschap centraal staan.

Maak van data inzichten die ertoe doen. Als Data & Insights Analyst vertaal je interne en externe data naar dashboards, analyses en kernboodschappen die strategie, performance, portfoliosturing en ExCo-besluitvorming ondersteunen.

Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je ontsluit en combineert databronnen en bewaakt kwaliteit, definities en herleidbaarheid;

  • Je ontwikkelt en beheert Power BI-dashboards die strategie- en portfolioperformance inzichtelijk maken en ExCo ondersteunen bij onderbouwde besluitvorming;

  • Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere analyses en kernboodschappen voor management en ExCo;

  • Je levert betrouwbare inzichten voor de kwartaalreviews, op basis van maandrapportages en aanvullende analyses;

  • Je verrijkt interne analyses met markt-, klant- en concurrentie-inzichten;

  • Je verdiept inzichten met scenario- en oorzaakanalyses;

  • Je signaleert trends, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en mogelijkheden om bij te sturen;

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
jobs.description:
Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team

Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy

Location - Utrecht


About iwell

At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead.

We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. 

We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact.


The Role

The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day.

Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems.

Success in this role means being able to:

  • Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code.

  • Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering.

What you will do

  • Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan.

  • Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from.

  • Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle.

  • Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing.

  • Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses..


What are looking for

  • 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code.

  • A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code.

  • A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't.

  • Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required.

  • Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours 

  • Coming into the office 3-4 days per week


Bonus points for

None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around.

  • Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience..

  • Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest.

  • Data analysis experience

  • Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets.

  • The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team.


Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future.


What we offer

  • A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance

  • 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. What You'll Do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defense for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to UK labor laws, employment standards, site-specific contracts, and safety protocols.

  • Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

  • Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers.

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

jobs.title: Customer Success Internship (German speaking)
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What You’ll Do

Dive in as the strategic force behind our post-sales customer journey, transforming satisfaction into a powerful engine for growth. As a key player in a nimble, high-impact team, you'll own the customer experience for the DACH market, shaping processes and driving initiatives that directly enhance customer lifetime value and accelerate our market expansion.

  • Architect and implement a best-in-class post-sales strategy for the DACH market, serving as the expert for all customer-related initiatives and elevating their lifetime value.

  • Proactively identify and resolve complex customer challenges, utilizing creative problem-solving to ensure customer satisfaction while leveraging insights to drive improvements.

  • Design, champion, and operationalize highly scalable processes that enhance customer experience, working in tandem with other internal teams to ensure operational excellence.

  • Manage end-to-end post-sales journeys, including onboarding, claims handling, and delivery issues, to ensure the successful resolution of customer queries, whether large or small.

  • Drive critical cross-functional alignment with Tech, Logistics, and other departments, ensuring customer insights directly inform roadmaps.

  • Execute high-touch, multi-channel communication, engaging directly with customers via phone and email to resolve inquiries and provide a premium support experience.

Who You Are

You're a hands-on and execution-driven individual contributor with a proven track record of shaping outcomes in fast-paced environments. As a vital member of a small team, you're ready to make a significant impact on our customer success architecture and contribute directly to our disruptive mission in the DACH market.

  • You are enrolled in a university or have recently graduated and you are looking to gain work experience in a fast paced venture backed environment (minimum 6 months).

  • Deeply curious and passionately aligned with the vision of hyper-growth startups, eager to contribute to scaling.

  • You are motivated and passionate about new ideas and possess a creative solution oriented mindset.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills in German and English. C1 German is required for this role.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. jobs.title: Director Space Business

Destinus is seeking a Director, Space Business to establish and grow its space business, with military satellite communications (Satcom) as the initial priority. Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will lead business development and programme delivery, supported by programme managers and a Technical Lead with communications systems expertise. The Director must have enough technical depth to challenge proposals and lead informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the business. Define the Satcom business plan, customer priorities, investment needs and Destinus' role in the industrial partnership. Align proposals with technical feasibility, funding and delivery capacity.
  • Secure customers and programmes. Build relationships with defence customers, space agencies and industrial partners. Lead proposals, commercial negotiations and funding opportunities in coordination with the group commercial team.

  • Build the required team. Recruit business and programme staff within approved plans. Define engineering capability needs with the CTO and establish clear responsibilities for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage industrial partnerships. Select and manage partners and suppliers with the relevant functions. Establish workshare, interfaces and delivery commitments across the complete Satcom system.

  • Maintain delivery discipline. Track costs, risks and progress. Resolve issues within the agreed mandate and escalate material changes to scope, investment or portfolio priorities.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Substantial experience in space, aerospace or defence, typically 12+ years, including at least five years leading complex programmes, multidisciplinary teams or a business.

  • Business development experience with government or defence customers, including shaping requirements, preparing proposals and negotiating contracts or programme funding.
  • An engineering degree or equivalent technical background, with a system-level understanding of satellites, communications payloads, user terminals and the ground segment.

German language skills as well as experience with German defense customers and space programmes are advantages.   • Implement, optimize and maintain various serial protocols
  • Design and develop interface tools to improve abstraction between the embedded system and other satellite components 
  • Debug and resolve complex embedded systems issues in a timely manner
  • Write and maintain technical documentation

 

Key Skills: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field
  • Mastery of Embedded C programming language

  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git)

Preferred Skills: 

  • Experience with space systems or satellite technology
  • Familiarity working to coding standards and using static analysis tools
  • Experience writing Rust for resource constrained environments (embedded Linux)
  • Experience with embedded Linux
  • Knowledge of control systems and algorithms

 

Tools and Technologies:

  • FreeRTOS for real-time operating system implementation
  • GNU ARM Embedded Toolchain for code compilation
  • GDB for debugging, complemented by extensive use of serial and/or CAN debugging

jobs.title: Senior Pricing Analyst
jobs.description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!

🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🧮 Pricing at Laka

Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do.

Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners.

We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help.

🤘🏼 The role

You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment.
  • Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals.
  • Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms.
  • Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data.
  • Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst.

You'll be successful by:

  • Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us.
  • Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time.
  • Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year.

Requirements

🚀 Sound like you?

  • 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:
    • Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live.
    • Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other.
    • Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL.
    • Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability.
    • Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team.
    • Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on.
    • Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work.
  • Plus points:
    • Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced.
    • Dutch, German or French.
    • An interest in cycling.

Benefits

🌟 Our perks

🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!)

📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join

💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually

🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year

💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future

💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost)

🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours

💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun!

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts

🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions

🌈 Belonging at Laka

We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com

jobs.employer: ECOLE NATIONALE SUPERIEURE DE TECHNIQUES AVANCEES
jobs.description:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

 

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne.  Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

 

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.

Missions / Activité annexe :

·       Contribuer à toute activité du service en fonction des priorités retenues.

·       Contribuer à la démarche Qualité, notamment via la rédaction et la mise à jour des procédures, le renseignement et le suivi des indicateurs

·       Contribuer à la démarche RSE de l’Ecole dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : CDD de 3 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : dès que possible

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus Paris-Saclay, 828 boulevard des Maréchaux 91762 Palaiseau – Cedex

Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) mais également par les transports en commun

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 18 RTT annuels)

  •        Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  •        Possibilité de télétravail (après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  •        Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  •        Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion, centre de loisirs pour les enfants du personnel à partir de 6 ans avec tarifs préférentiels (campus Paris-Saclay)

  •        Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

Les candidats retenus doivent posséder de solides compétences scientifiques et être très motivés. La maîtrise de l'anglais parlé et écrit est obligatoire.

Les candidats effectueront des recherches, développeront des dispositifs et des outils expérimentaux et rédigeront des articles scientifiques en étroite collaboration avec le PI du projet, Pr. Ioannis Stefanou, et les membres du groupe INJECT.

          

 Connaissances :

·       Une expérience dans le domaine des essais expérimentaux et de la conception (par exemple en géotechnique/géophysique/géomécanique) ou un diplôme de fin d'études dans ce domaine.

jobs.description:
Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

 

Le projet AMRIT : 

Aujourd’hui, en Europe, l’exploitation des plateformes d’observation in situ s’appuie sur un réseau d’infrastructures de recherche réparties sur l’ensemble du continent. Les activités menées au sein de ce réseau comprennent des opérations in situ et à distance en mer, ainsi que la gestion des données issues d’un grand nombre de ressources pour une large gamme d’applications. Ces activités nécessitent d’importantes ressources informatiques, des efforts de R&D visant à améliorer les capacités des plateformes, ainsi que des activités de gestion et de financement pour assurer le fonctionnement des infrastructures et en garantir l’accès. AMRIT (Advance Marine Research Infrastructures Together) est un projet pionnier conçu pour révolutionner le paysage des infrastructures de recherche marine (MRI) en Europe, en renforçant leur capacité à répondre aux enjeux politiques européens et aux défis scientifiques mondiaux.

AMRIT (https://www.amritproject.eu/) est un projet financé par Horizon Europe et l’UKRI, réunissant 26 partenaires européens, et destiné à faire progresser les MRIs au plan de leur coordination, en proposant la fédération de certains de leurs services informatiques. Il est coordonné scientifiquement par l’ENSTA. En développant des outils et des services pour la conduite des opérations des plateformes d’observation marine, AMRIT vise à :

  • Assurer un fonctionnement sans faille des plateformes d’observation marine.

  • Garantir la pleine utilisation nominale des capteurs et accélérer leur évolution.

  • Exploiter la complémentarité des différentes plateformes d’observation.

  • Assurer la cohérence globale de la chaîne de valeur des données océaniques.

  • Garantir une liste cohérente et exhaustive de métadonnées et de descripteurs.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du Campus de Brest.

Missions / Activités principales :

emetriq, Teil der Deutschen Telekom AG, bietet datengetriebene Online-Advertising-Lösungen und setzt sich für fairen Datenzugang als Treibstoff für Innovation und Vielfalt ein. Mit deinem Know-how in AdTech, Tracking und Kampagnenmanagement schaffst du die Grundlage für eine präzise Auslieferung, valide Daten und den Erfolg unserer digitalen Werbemaßnahmen.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Technische Kampagnenumsetzung sicherstellen: Du legst Spiegelkampagnen in Adform an und pflegst Werbemittel in verschiedenen DSPs. So schaffst du die technische Grundlage für eine zuverlässige Kampagnenauslieferung

  • Tracking-Setups erfolgreich umsetzen: Du implementierst Pixel, Clicktracking und Redirects, prüfst deren Qualität und sorgst für belastbare Tracking-Setups

  • Qualität und Standards gewährleisten: Du stellst die Einhaltung von Naming Conventions sicher und sorgst für konsistente, transparente Kampagnenstrukturen

  • AdTech-Systeme intelligent vernetzen: Du betreust die technische Anbindung von Exactag und DoubleVerify und weiteren AdTech-Lösungen und stellst ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel sicher

  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Du analysierst Zählabweichungen in Spiegelkampagnen, identifizierst Fehlerquellen und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen

  • Dynamische Werbemittel erfolgreich ausspielen: Du richtest DCO-Banner inklusive Produktfeeds, Angeboten und Zielgruppen-Segmenten ein und stellst deren fehlerfreie Auslieferung über Adserver und DSPs sicher

  • Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit stärken: Gemeinsam mit Media Planning, Kreation und Data entwickelst du technische Lösungen für erfolgreiche Kampagnen

  • Unser Toolstack:

    • DV360, Adform, TheTradeDesk, AmazonDSP, Google Ads Manager

    • Exactag, DoubleVerify, Audience Project


Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung in Ad Operations: Du bringst Erfahrung im Bereich Ad Operations mit – idealerweise aus einer Agentur oder der Telekommunikationsbranche

  • Fundiertes Tracking-Know-how: Tracking-Setups, Tagging-Konzepte und technische Fehleranalysen gehören für dich zum Arbeitsalltag.

  • Verständnis für AdTech-Ökosysteme: Du kennst dich mit Adservern, DSPs und technischen Schnittstellen aus und verstehst deren Zusammenspiel

  • Sicherer Umgang mit macOS: Du bewegst dich sicher in der Apple-Welt und nutzt moderne Arbeitswerkzeuge selbstverständlich

  • Nice to have: Web-Analytics-Erfahrung, JavaScript-Grundkenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Website-Tracking, Interesse an Prozessoptimierung

Wir bei emetriq sind ein Team aus Experten, die gemeinsam wachsen und das Unternehmen voranbringen möchten. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf Vertrauen, Agilität, Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung – ohne starre Hierarchien, aber mit klaren Entwicklungsperspektiven. Mut zur Veränderung, Arbeiten auf Augenhöhe und teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit prägen unsere Kultur.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

This role sits at the heart of marketing and growth, integrating brand, product, content, lifecycle, and performance into a single demand strategy that fuels revenue across segments.

You’ll lead a high-performing team across all channels including paid media, SEO, ABM, Field Marketing and funnel conversion, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and RevOps to drive outcomes.

  • Deliver full-funnel pipeline growth: Drive consistent, scalable pipeline across channels (paid, SEO, ABM, lifecycle, web), tailored by segment, persona, and motion.

  • Build and scale repeatable programs: Design and execute high-impact, segment-specific campaigns that convert across startup, scale-up, and mid-market/enterprise tiers.

  • Develop our ABM motion: Create and optimise 1:1, 1:few, and 1:many programs to engage and accelerate high-value accounts in our upmarket GTM.

  • Build the systems to scale: Ensure the right martech, data infrastructure, and operating cadence is in place to support repeatable, insight-led growth.

  • Lead a high-performing team: Hire, coach, and inspire a team of channel owners, strategists, and ops leads, driving clear accountability and shared outcomes.

Where You’ll Collaborate

Paddle for others

Paddle simply

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

 

Every day, physicians across The Netherlands lose hours to documentation instead of patients. Tandem gives that time back - and clinicians actually use it. That’s rare in health tech, and it changes the way you sell: you’re not convincing people they have a problem, you’re showing them a better way to work.

 

We’re building the Dutch market properly - a real product with real pull, backed to win, and a sales team being built right now. If you want to contribute something being built for healthcare in the right way, this is the room to be in.

About Tandem

 

Tandem builds AI that gives time back to physicians, therapists and nurses. Our team of clinicians, psychologists and AI engineers builds close to the reality of care - pairing modern technology with medical expertise to cut administrative load and free up time for patients.

• 200+ people, founded August 2023

• $160m raised, backed by leading European VCs (EQT, Northzone, Kinnevik) and angels from companies like OpenAI

• Product already live and in daily clinical use across Europe in +10,000 healthcare organisations (1500 in The Netherlands)

 

About the role

At Tandem Health, we’re building a clinician copilot that gives time back to care teams so clinicians can focus on patients. You'll be dealing with complex customers to win them over and expand our market share in the Netherlands.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own the full cycle: qualify, demo, negotiate, close

  • Run a high throughput of meetings while keeping every conversation consultative, not transactional

  • Present the product to clinicians and decision-makers and translate their documentation pain into a clear reason to act

  • Manage relationships through to a live, happy customer, working closely with your SDR and MedOps

  • Stay engaged in your customer relationships long term, update and upsell them on new developments and features

  • Feed what you hear in the market back to product

  • Represent Tandem at events across the region

 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales, previous experience in field sales, door-to-door prospecting, or territory-based commercial roles.

  • A track record of hitting and beating quota - and you can prove it with concrete numbers

  • The consultative, lead-from-the-front selling style described in “How we sell”

  • Native-level Dutch and C1/C2 English

  • Experience selling to healthcare professionals (clinics, private practices, care providers) or working in regulated environments.

  • Experience in digital products, SaaS, or technology that improves professional workflows.

 
 

How we sell (our culture)

We hire salespeople who lead, not ones who wait for a script:

  • You bring a point of view - you help a clinician see their documentation burden in a new light, instead of listing features.

  • You tailor the message to whoever is across the table: practice owner, chief physician, or administration.

  • You lead the conversation and put the hard topics - including price - on the table early, rather than hoping they don’t come up.

  • You are relentless about results and back what you say with numbers.

 

What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Leiden, your choice of IT equipment

 

Location & way of working

Netherlands-based · Hybrid · Fully Leiden-based preferred

Compensation

Competitive base + uncapped OTE

We building a team that reflects the world we want to change, and we welcome applicants of every background.

Cyberangriffe erkennen, Sicherheitsvorfälle analysieren und Kundenumgebungen wirksam schützen – genau das motiviert dich? Du möchtest aktiv zur Cybersecurity beitragen, entwickelst Detection-Mechanismen und automatisierte Security-Prozesse weiter und behältst auch bei kritischen Incidents einen kühlen Kopf? Du hast Freude daran, Sicherheitsrisiken gezielt zu reduzieren und gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Schutzmassnahmen umzusetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Wir suchen in Fehraltorf oder Aarau eine/n

Security Operations Engineer 80–100 % (m/w/d)

UPGREAT mit Sitz in Fehraltorf und Aarau ist Dein kompetenter Partner für Outsourcing, Modern Work und Cloudlösungen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur basiert auf den drei Grundwerten: Begeisterung, Menschlichkeit und Kompetenz.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Betrieb & Weiterentwicklung: Du verantwortest den sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, das Monitoring sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Toolings, unserer Security-Services und der Kundenumgebungen.

  • Security Incident Management: Du bearbeitest Security-Events, Incidents und Findings end-to-end – von der Triage und Analyse über Containment und Kundenkommunikation bis hin zum Post-Incident-Review und zur vollständigen Dokumentation.

  • Detection Engineering & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst und optimierst Detection Use Cases, Playbooks und Automatisierungen und reduzierst False Positives nachhaltig, indem du deren Ursachen identifizierst und behebst.

  • Vulnerability & Patch Management: Du steuerst das Vulnerability- und Patch-Management über mehrere Kundenumgebungen hinweg, insbesondere bei kritischen Schwachstellen und Zero-Day-Exploits. Dabei priorisierst du Massnahmen anhand von Exposition, Ausnutzbarkeit und Risiko.

  • Security Services & Kundenberatung: Du erbringst rund 50 % deiner Tätigkeit als verrechenbare Security-Leistungen direkt beim Kunden. Dazu gehören Onboardings, Security-Baselines, Reviews, Reporting und die fachliche Beratung.

  • Zusammenarbeit & Stellvertretung: Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Engineering, KAM, CISO und externen Security-Partnern zusammen und stellst durch gegenseitige Stellvertretung einen zuverlässigen und kontinuierlichen Betrieb sicher.

  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zur Verkürzung der Erkennungs- und Reaktionszeiten (MTTD/MTTR), zur Erhöhung der Detection-Abdeckung sowie zur Standardisierung und Skalierung unserer Security-Services.

  • Toolmaking: Du entwickelst Tools und Skripte, die manuelle Abläufe vereinfachen oder vollständig automatisieren und so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer IT-Prozesse beitragen.

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

    Zastupovanie vedúceho prevádzky v čase jeho neprítomnosti a podpora pri riadení prevádzky.Výhody:ubytovanie, - práca v stabilnej spoločnosti s dlhoročnou tradíciou

jobs.title: Pánski a dámski krajčíri, kožušníci a klobučníci
jobs.description: Hľadáte prácu, kde sa vaša precíznosť premení na jedinečné módne kúsky? Pre úspešnú slovenskú módnu návrhárku hľadáme šikovnú a detailne orientovanú krajčírku, ktorá má vášeň pre módu a nebojí sa krajčírskeho remesla na najvyššej úrovni.Ak radi pracujete s kvalitnými materiálmi a chcete vidieť výsledky svojej práce na prehliadkových mólach či exkluzívnych klientoch, poďte pracovať do nášho ateliéru!Náplň práce: v čom budete vynikať?•    Kompletné šitie modelov (od spoločenských šiat až po limitované každodenné kolekcie) podľa návrhov a strihových predlôh.•    Práca s luxusnými a jemnými materiálmi (hodváb, čipka, vlna, satén).•    Úprava a dopasovanie modelov priamo na mieru zákazníčkam počas skúšok.•    Spolupráca s módnou návrhárkou pri realizácii nových nápadov a detailov.•    Ručné práce a precízne finálne úpravy (našívanie aplikácií, gombíkov, začisťovanie). Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.description: Join the Crew. With a job tailored to you. Wir sind Tom Tailor, casual Fashion- und Lifestyle-Brand aus Hamburg. jobs.title: Senior global project manager
jobs.description: Reference: 26|HQ|SRM01Location: Geneva, with occasional travelsLine management: Reports to the Head of Global ProgrammesContract duration: Open ended contractStart date: ASAPFUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIESThe Global Project Manager's responsibilities will be delivered under the supervision of the Head of Global Programmes and in close collaboration with all SLT members, HQ departments and country teams, particularly the Head of PPS. The role serves as a key programme management focal point across complex global programmes, supporting effective coordination, decision-making and follow-up across multiple stakeholders and functions. They will include:1. PROJECT COORDINATION AND DONOR REPORTINGOversee the implementation of assigned global projects and ensure progress against approved activities, deliverables, indicators, budgets and contractual commitments, building from existing tracking tools implemented by PPS and Finance teams where relevant.Develop and maintain detailed project-level workplans that can be shared with all project stakeholders to increase visibility on project ambitions, timelines and status.Coordinate project kick off meetings and regular project progress and quality reviews with Global Programmes Managers, country teams, partners and relevant HQ departments;Maintain oversight of contractually required deliverables and reporting deadlines across assigned grants and coordinate/consolidate high-quality narrative reporting to institutional donors, including inputs from country teams, partners and relevant HQ departments;In close coordination with the Project and Partnership Support (PPS) and Finance teams, coordinate donor queries and contractual modifications, including amendments, budget revisions and no-cost extensions, as required;2. RISK IDENTIFICATION AND MANAGEMENTIdentify implementation delays, bottlenecks and risks, and support relevant teams in defining and following up on corrective measures;In the case of major risks that can have organizational implications or require cross-department engagement, ensure, via the Head of Global Programmes, that the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team are informed and enabled to take action.When required, liaise with Finance and PPS teams to initiate possible contractual realignment;Ensure that implementation challenges, lessons learned and associated mitigation measures are appropriately documented and leveraged in subsequent phases of the project.3. POOLED FUND MANAGEMENTIn collaboration with the Head of Global Programmes and the Head of PPS, support the coordination internal pooled funding and allocation mechanisms, from the preparation of allocation processes through tracking of activity progress and deliverables;Coordinate the review and follow-up of allocations, ensuring processes are appropriately documented and aligned with project objectives and donor requirements;Monitor implementation, deliverables and reporting across recipient countries and maintain a consolidated overview of progress;Liaise with the Projects and Partnership support team Finance Department to ensure organizational visibility around implementation delays, under-spending and other risks and facilitate corrective action, reprogramming or reallocation where required.4. DONOR AND PARTNER ENGAGEMENTEngage with project focal points on the donor side to provide updates on activity progress, and help orient them to the right focal points within the organization depending on their queries (for example, re-direct questions around contracting and payment modalities to the PPS or finance teams).For projects delivered in a consortium (as of October 2026, the ECHO Policy HIP project) :Track partners’ activity progress against project level workplans, and consolidate reporting.Facilitate and chair partner meetings to provide and collect progress updates on the delivery of the project, identify and troubleshoot delivery issues.Ensure partners understand and comply with relevant project, donor and IMPACT programmatic, financial and reporting requirements, and communicate any compliance risks promptly with PPS for action.Identify partnership-related challenges or compliance issues and facilitate their timely resolution with the support of PPS and Finance teams.5. FUNDRAISINGIn close coordination with the Head of Global Programmes and the PPS team, initiate engagement with existing donors around project renewals or extensionsConvene project activity leads and key partners around the identification of programmatic priorities for the next iteration of projects in the context of a renewalIn support of the Executive Team, contribute to funding diversification by supporting the implementation of an organizational fundraising appeal, which may require engagement and relationship building with new institutional donors as well as philanthropies.With the support of the Communications and Advocacy and Global Programmes team, develop fundraising materials that can help convey IMPACT’s value added to a wide variety of potential funding partners across the humanitarian, development and private sectors.KEY DELIVERABLESAssigned global and multi-country projects are implemented in line with agreed workplans, budgets, deliverables and donor requirements.High-quality donor reports and other contractual deliverables are consolidated and submitted on time.Up-to-date consolidated project monitoring provides clear visibility on implementation progress, expenditure, risks and upcoming milestones.Pooled fund allocations are effectively managed and monitored from allocation through implementation and close-out.Implementing partnerships are effectively established and followed up, with timely identification and resolution of implementation and compliance issues.REQUIREMENTSExcellent academic qualifications, including Master's degree in a relevant discipline (e.g. project management, development, humanitarian studies, international relations, research methods, social sciences).At least 10 years of experience in the development or humanitarian sector; experience in field-based roles and across multiple geographies an asset.Familiarity with needs assessments and analysis, applied research in humanitarian or development settings.Familiarity with the humanitarian system and global humanitarian policy frameworks, in particular the Grand Bargain, the HPC and the JIAF.Demonstrated experience directly managing and implementing humanitarian projects, preferably including experience at country/field level. Experience with complex, multi-country and/or multi-partner projects is a strong asset;Demonstrated experience managing institutional donor grants throughout the project cycle, including implementation follow-up, donor reporting and contractual compliance;Strong understanding of institutional donor requirements; prior experience with ECHO, Sida, SDC, GAC and/or comparable institutional donors is highly desirable;Demonstrated experience working with implementing partners, including partnership set-up, implementation follow-up and reporting; example leading complex consortia a strong asset.Excellent organisational, coordination and planning skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines and coordinate effectively across teams, countries and functions;Excellent communication and drafting skills for effective reporting.Strong interpersonal skills, including good external engagement and coordination skills.Willingness and ability for short term deployments, including to complex and challenging security environments.Ability to operate in a cross-cultural environment requiring flexibility.Fluency in English and French required, given the regional remit of the position; Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese or Ukrainian an asset.Ability to operate InDesign is a plus.COMPENSATION & BENEFITSFor this position, gross salary between 5,892 CHF and 6,221 CHF monthly (before income tax). NB - IMPACT salaries are strictly determined by our salary grid depending on the grade of the position and the level of education and experience of staff. A contribution to medical insurance of 489 CHF per month is already included in the salary figure.Insurance covering professional and non-professional accidents throughout the period of employment with IMPACTHealth insurance, life insurance and repatriation assistance in case of field visits/temporary deploymentsEnrolment in IMPACT Initiatives Research Foundational Learning Programme within the first 3 months from the start of contract.Applicants must hold a valid work permit for Switzerland or be EU/EFTA citizensUp to 40% of remote work on a weekly basis

Conception Mécanique \- Mécanisation de Chantiers.    Dans un contexte d'innovation et d'exploration de nouveaux marchés, notre client renforce ses équipes de conception afin d'accompagner le développement de solutions destinées à transformer les méthodes d'interventions sur les infrastructures ferroviaires.    Cette création de poste répond à une ambition claire : identifier les opportunités de mécanisation de demain et imaginer les machines capables de répondre aux défis opérationnels des chantiers du futur.    Cette fonction s'adresse à un ingénieur curieux, doté d'une véritable sensibilité terrain et souhaitant évoluer au\-delà du bureau d'études traditionnel.    Vous serez amené à comprendre les problématiques des utilisateurs, observer les chantiers, dialoguer avec les clients et transformer ces observations en concepts innovants et projets de développement concrets.**Votre mission**À la croisée de l'innovation, de la conception mécanique et de l'analyse des besoins clients, vous contribuez à imaginer les futures solutions de mécanisation destinées aux chantiers ferroviaires.    Votre rôle consiste à comprendre les méthodes de travail actuelles, identifier leurs limites et anticiper les évolutions nécessaires pour améliorer la performance, la sécurité et l'efficacité des opérations.    Pour cela, vous allez à la rencontre des utilisateurs, active des pratiques opérationnelles et vous rendez régulièrement sur les chantiers afin d'observer les méthodes utilisées sur le terrain.    Vos échanges avec les exploitants, entreprises informations afin de les transformer en exigences techniques et fonctionnelles exploitables par les équipes d'ingénierie.    Dans cette démarche, vous participez à l'évaluation de nouvelles opportunités de développement et contribuez à la définition de concepts innovants répondant aux enjeux actuels et futurs des chantiers ferroviaires.    Vous prenez également part aux activités de conception mécanique, depuis les études préliminaires jusqu'au développement des solutions retenues.    Vous participez à la rédaction de documents techniques, au suivi des développements, au contrôle des études et à la coordination avec les différentes équipes impliquées dans les projets.    Enfin, vous contribuez à représenter l'entreprise lors des visites terrain et participez ponctuellement à des échanges liés à l'évolution des pratiques et des normes du secteur.**Votre profil**Titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur HES, Master en mécanique ou formation jugée équivalente, vous justifiez
