comprendre rapidement des problématiques opérationnelles, d'en faire la synthèse et de les traduire en solutions techniques réalistes et innovantes.    Vous êtes reconnu pour votre curiosité intellectuelle, votre capacité d'analyse ainsi que votre aisance relationnelle.    Les situations nouvelles vous stimulent et vous aimez explorer des sujets encore peu structurés afin d'en faire émerger des opportunités de développement.    La maîtrise du français, de l'anglais et de l'allemand est recherchée afin d'évoluer efficacement dans un contexte international et de collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés.**Ce que notre client vous offre**Notre client vous propose un poste rare, situé à la frontière entre innovation, ingénierie et compréhension des besoins du marché.    Vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler sur des sujets émergents et de participer directement à la réflexion autour des futures technologies et méthodes de mécanisation.    Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où les idées peuvent rapidement devenir des projets concrets et où les interactions avec les clients et les utilisateurs finaux permettent de mesurer directement l'impact des développements réalisés.    Cette fonction offre également de réelles perspectives d'évolution, notamment vers des responsabilités accrues en gestion de projets ou dans le développement de nouvelles jobs.title: Semiconductor Metrology & Quality Control Technician – 100%
jobs.description: Are you the person who enjoy precise, hands-on work with wafers and chips in a cleanroom, and operating metrology equipment such as optical microscopes, die-sorting, SEM? At Lightium, we're building the next generation of thin-film lithium niobate photonic integrated circuits to help AI infrastructure run faster. As we move from development toward volume production, we're looking for a Metrology & Quality Control Technician to own the measurement, inspection and sorting of our wafers and chips, and to make sure every part that leaves Lightium is exactly what our customers expect. Position Summary As part of our Operations team, you will be the day-to-day responsible for metrology and quality control, as well as die sorting and packaging in our semiconductor cleanroom. You will characterize wafers and chips with a broad set of metrology tools (including optical microscopes, SEM), run incoming and outgoing inspection, operate the pick-and-place machine for die sorting and package and document our products with full traceability. You will work closely with our process, design and test engineers, as well as with fab partners and suppliers. Precision and reliable execution are at the core of the job, and your experience will help shape the way we measure, inspect and release our products as we scale. Key Responsibilities Metrology: Perform wafer- and chip-level measurements using SEM, stylus profilometer, optical and confocal microscopes, and ellipsometer (e.g., film thickness, critical dimensions, etch depth and step height, surface topography and defects). Set up and maintain measurement recipes, keep tools calibrated and in good working condition, and coordinate with service providers when needed.  Sorting & Packaging: Sort chips and dies by hand using manual and vacuum tweezers, as well as operate our pick & place machine to sort dies from singulated wafers on tape to industry-standards shipping containers such as GelPak, waffle pack, JEDEC tray. Handle wafer taping, die marking, final sorting, packaging and sealing in vacuum bags. Data & Reporting: Record, analyze and report measurement results in a clear and traceable way, compliant with our data-stack and data ingestion processes. Promptly flag out-of-spec results and deviations to engineering, support root-cause investigations, and help trend key parameters over time. Incoming Quality Control: Inspect incoming wafers, chips and critical materials from fab partners and suppliers against specifications, complete goods acceptance documentation, and handle nonconforming material in coordination with internal stakeholders. Outgoing Quality Control: Perform final visual and dimensional inspection of chips and wafers before shipment, prepare Certificates of Conformance (CoC) and inspection reports for customers, and ensure that packaging meets our quality standards. Traceability: Ensure full traceability of every wafer and chip through consistent labeling and identification, keep inventory and traceability records accurate in our ERP, PLM system for data traceability, and help maintain the same standards across our R&D and production lines. Procedures & Improvement: Contribute to writing and updating work instructions and inspection and measurement procedures as part of our growing quality management system, and suggest practical improvements based on your daily work, including suggestions for engineers for better automations and improvements of our MES system.  What you’ll bring Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in metrology and quality control in semiconductor, photonics, MEMS or a related micro- and nanofabrication environment such as watch industry and medical instruments. Technical education such as an EFZ apprenticeship (e.g., Mikrotechnologe/in, Physiklaborant/in), a higher technical diploma, or an FH degree in a related field. Metrology Know-how: Hands-on operation of SEM, profilometry, optical and confocal microscopy, ellipsometry, as well as pick-and-place machine for die sorting. Solid experience and dexterity with manual handling of wafers and chips with tweezers. Solid understanding of inspection criteria for wafers and dies. Cleanroom Experience: Proven experience working in ISO 5 / ISO 6 cleanrooms and gray-rooms, operating cleanroom equipment ensuring compliance with cleanroom requirements, as well as preventive and regular maintenance and calibration of tools. Precision & Work Ethic: Meticulous, reliable and hardworking. You take pride in getting things right the first time and in documenting your work so others can trust your results. Quality Mindset: Familiarity with quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001), nonconformance handling and traceability. Experience preparing CoCs or inspection reports is a plus. Tools: Comfortable with Microsoft 365, especially Excel for data analysis. Experience with ERP and PLM systems as well as automation and MES is a plus. Interested in using AI tools such as Claude in your daily work. Language Skills: Good English is preferred. German or French or Italian is a plus.

jobs.title: Lab Manager and Experimental Technical Support Staff
jobs.description: EinleitungstextAt the IDEAL Lab, we develop algorithms and computational models that design physical hardware and validate those designs via physical experiments. We have a growing physical footprint that includes 3D printers, a custom foam cutter, several robotic arms (UR5e), and a variety of small mechatronic test rigs that change depending on the project. We also have a large teaching profile with ~20-30 Bachelor's and Master's students joining the lab each semester for various projects, a subset of which involve robotics or mechatronics-related experiments.ProjekthintergrundWe are looking for a part-time technical staff member to act as a Lab Manager and/or coordinating technician, depending on the skillset of the person. The specific roles and responsibilities of this person — and the amount of time/effort required from them — would depend on what they could do based on their experience or desire for future training/growth. The core task would be basic lab operations and safety, as mentioned below — anticipated ~20% time — with an optional/desired role for additional time being the engineering and student support — initially anticipated at 20% time, however, this has the option to grow in the future depending on the skills, usefulness, and desires of the specific candidate.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungBasic Lab Operations and Safety (~20% time):Act as the General Safety Representative for the lab. Train incoming students/staff on safety rules and how to use shared equipment (trainings occur 3-4 times per year for 1-2 hours). Update the safety concept, e.g., once per year or as needed.Keep the lab spaces operational, such as managing inventory, handling purchase requests for supplies, retrieving packages as needed, and working with students to ensure workstations are kept clean and organized. Coordinate the once-a-year lab cleaning day with staff.Coordinate with staff and students on the maintenance and use of shared equipment such as the 3D printers, robots, and hand tools, as well as repairs when things break, as per the safety concept. This can include delegating tasks to existing staff if appropriate.Act as a point of contact for student questions about where equipment or supplies are located in the lab space. Generally share personal knowledge and maintain personal relationships. Guide students toward other ETH resources (like other technical workshops or facilities) outside of our immediate lab’s perimeter when they have specific questions/needs (e.g., ETH TechPool, off-site laser cutters, Instron machines, etc.).Attend any occasional lab operational meetings with the PI and other staff, or lab retreats as desired, although not recurring lab meetings (unless desired).Engineering and Student Support (~20% time):Where appropriate, support research goals by helping or consulting with students and staff to debug and run physical experiments they have planned. This could include helping them build or debug necessary rigs or platforms for various research projects, automating existing procedures from past research projects to make them easier to extend in the future, or building working knowledge of the lab’s robotic infrastructure to more quickly onboard new student projects. jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Microelectronics Design Center (DZ) of the Department of Information Technologies and Electrical Engineering (D-ITET) is a technical support group providing design tools, know-how and licenses for ASIC, FPGA, Embedded Systems and PCB design for research and teaching . This includes consulting, project planning, reviewing of active projects as well as participation in projects. To lead the area of Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design we are seeking a Senior Analog/Mixed-Signal IC Design Specialist starting 1st of January 2027 or by mutual agreement.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungYou will be part of an experienced team and be the expert for analog/mixed-signal in the DZ.You will own the analog/mixed-signal area of the IC design infrastructure and further develop it with the aim to provide support to researchers and students.You will support design flows covering all aspects of IC design with a strong focus on analog/mixed-signal design flows using the latest tools from Cadence Design System, Synopsys, Mentor Graphics and open-source tools.You will interact with students and researchers to help them with their IC design related questions, chip finishing and submission of ICs to fabrication through MPW and foundry contacts.You will also be asked to develop, adapt and maintain common building blocks for mixed-signal IC chips as well as the development of larger mixed-signal ICs.As part of a team supporting research and teaching at ETH Zurich, you will frequently be challenged to develop solutions for systems that stretch the boundaries of conventional approaches.You will be asked to help researchers and students through design reviews.You will also develop and deliver targeted training modules and hands-on laboratory sessions for students and researchers in these areas.In addition, you will contribute to the group's outreach and visibility by supporting its web presence and preparing periodic activity reports.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an experienced IC designer with strong expertise in analog/mixed-signal design, motivated to work in an environment where creative technical problem-solving supports researchers and students. Proficiency with UNIX, scripting languages, and IC design tools from major EDA vendors is also required. Good written and spoken English is essential for technical collaboration in a multicultural environment. Experience organizing technical training courses and undergraduate laboratory activities is highly desirable. The ideal candidate combines strong communication and technical skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences and is comfortable taking on a leading and senior technical role within the team.Wir bietenWe are a small support team of four permanent employees, and are looking forward to add a fifth member to the team. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our team. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. jobs.title: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)
jobs.description: Healthcare Patent Counsel, Digital Health (all genders)Your rôleAs Healthcare Patent Counsel, you will shape the U.S. and global intellectual property strategy for pharmaceutical development projects and commercial products, with a particular focus on digital health and integrated healthcare solutions. You will work at the intersection of pharmaceuticals, software, data, medical devices, and digital health to protect innovation and enable successful development and commercialization. Partnering with scientists, software experts, engineers, and other innovators, you will identify inventions and build patent portfolio strategies that support project and business objectives. Your work will span combination products, software-enabled medical devices, biomarkers, algorithms, data-driven solutions, and connected health ecosystems. You will draft, file, and prosecute patent applications in the United States, Europe, and other international jurisdictions. You will manage oppositions, post-grant proceedings, and other validity matters, including PGRs and IPRs. You will conduct and oversee freedom-to-operate analyses, turn complex findings into clear recommendations, and support patent enforcement, invalidation proceedings, and related legal opinions. You will provide intellectual property advice and negotiation support for contracts, collaborations, licenses, and business development transactions. As part of an expert group for Digital IP, you will advise colleagues across business areas on software, data analysis, and emerging digital technologies. Working closely with Pharmaceutical R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Business Development, and Legal teams, you will counsel senior leaders and help define the future of digital healthcare in a collaborative international environment. Who you are•    You hold a university degree in biomedical engineering, chemistry, biology, pharmaceutical sciences, or a related scientific discipline, together with strong bioinformatics expertise.•    You are registered to practice before the European Patent Office (EPO) and/or the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).•    You bring substantial experience in a patent department within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or life sciences industry, or in a law firm advising on digital health, software, medical devices, or related healthcare technologies.•    You have a strong understanding of patentability and legal issues relating to software, artificial intelligence and machine learning, data analytics, digital biomarkers, and personalized healthcare.•    You have demonstrated experience in patent drafting and prosecution, post-grant proceedings such as oppositions, PGRs, or IPRs, and freedom-to-operate analyses.•    You have supported or led contract negotiations involving intellectual property, licensing, collaborations, or related commercial arrangements.•    You communicate complex intellectual property matters clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and build trusted relationships with diverse stakeholders.•    You take a collaborative, proactive, and strategic approach, work effectively in international cross-functional teams, and understand the regulatory frameworks for pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and digital health solutions. https://careers.merckgroup.com/fr/fr/apply?jobSeqNo=MQAMKDGLOBAL303054EXTERNALFRFR&step=1&stepname=personalInformation

jobs.title: Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico-fonctionnelle
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico-fonctionnelle---Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico\-fonctionnelle=================================================================================La Fédération des Hôpitaux Vaudois informatique ( ), est le partenaire informatique privilégié de plus de 12 Hôpitaux et établissements de santé régionaux du canton de Vaud. La FHVi les accompagne dans les nombreux défis de la transformation digitale du domaine de la santé et a pour principales missions de planifier, concevoir, réaliser et exploiter le SI de ses membres. Ce sont plus de 100 collaborateurs au service de 10'000 utilisateurs, pour parc de plus de 7'000 postes de travail répartis sur une centaine de sites géographiques et sur trois cantons (VD, VS, FR).Le poste s'adresse indifféremment à une femme ou à un homme. A des fins de commodité de lecture, les termes ne sont qu'au masculin. Responsable d'applications cliniques Senior – Expertise technico\-fonctionnelle=================================================================================Et si votre expertise technique et votre capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes contribuaient directement à la performance des systèmes d'information hospitaliers ?Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre équipe en charge des systèmes d'information cliniques, nous recherchons un **Responsable d'applications Senior**, disposant d'une solide expertise technico\-fonctionnelle, d'une forte capacité d'analyse et d'une réelle autonomie dans la résolution de problématiques applicatives complexes.Ce poste s'adresse à un professionnel expérimenté qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement des applications dans leur globalité, investiguer les dysfonctionnements, identifier leurs causes profondes et proposer des solutions concrètes, fiables et adaptées aux besoins métier. **Votre mission :**En tant que Responsable d'applications Senior, vous assurez la responsabilité technique et fonctionnelle d'un portefeuille d'applications critiques du système d'information clinique, en garantissant leur disponibilité, leur performance, leur sécurité et leur évolution.Véritable référent technico\-fonctionnel, vous intervenez aussi bien sur la résolution d'incidents complexes que sur l'analyse des besoins métier, les évolutions applicatives et les études de faisabilité.Vous êtes capable de passer d'une problématique fonctionnelle à une investigation technique approfondie, puis à la définition et à la mise en œuvre d'une solution adaptée.Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les utilisateurs des établissements hospitaliers, les équipes informatiques internes et les fournisseurs de solutions.Votre rôle repose sur un équilibre entre expertise opérationnelle, compréhension métier, autonomie technique et capacité à prendre du recul sur les solutions proposées. **Vos principales activités et responsabilité :** **Gestion applicative et résolution d'incidents complexes*** Assurer le maintien en condition opérationnelle des applications de votre périmètre et garantir leur disponibilité, leur performance et leur fiabilité.  * Prendre en charge les incidents applicatifs complexes nécessitant une analyse approfondie des dimensions fonctionnelles et techniques.  * Investiguer les dysfonctionnements de manière autonome, identifier leurs causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des solutions correctives durables.  * Analyser les interactions et dépendances entre applications, bases de données, serveurs, interfaces et composants techniques.  * Exploiter les bases de données, notamment au travers de requêtes SQL avancées, pour analyser les anomalies et identifier les actions correctives.  * Réaliser les premières investigations techniques et solliciter les expertises spécialisées lorsque la situation le nécessite.  * Anticiper les risques liés aux évolutions technologiques, aux incompatibilités et à l'obsolescence des composants applicatifs.   **Expertise technique et intégration des systèmes*** Comprendre les architectures applicatives et les mécanismes d'intégration entre systèmes hétérogènes.  * Analyser les échanges de données, les interfaces et les webservices afin d'identifier et de résoudre les problèmes d'interopérabilité.  * Lire, comprendre et analyser du code existant, notamment en environnement C\#/.NET, afin de faciliter les investigations et les évolutions applicatives.  * Exploiter et adapter des scripts, notamment PowerShell, pour automatiser certaines opérations ou contribuer à la résolution de problèmes.  * Intervenir sur les problématiques liées aux environnements applicatifs Windows, aux bases de données et aux dépendances techniques.  * Collaborer avec les équipes de développement, d'infrastructure et d'interopérabilité pour assurer la cohérence et la maintenabilité des solutions.   **Évolution des applications et analyse des besoins métier*** Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins exprimés par les utilisateurs et les établissements hospitaliers.  * Comprendre les processus métier dans leur globalité et mesurer les impacts des évolutions sur les utilisateurs et les applications interconnectées.  * Traduire les besoins opérationnels en solutions fonctionnelles et techniques adaptées.  * Réaliser des analyses de faisabilité intégrant les contraintes techniques, les dépendances, les coûts, les délais et les risques.  * Proposer des solutions pragmatiques, proportionnées aux besoins et compatibles avec les ressources disponibles.  * Participer à la planification et à la réalisation des évolutions applicatives, des montées de version et des projets de transformation.  * Organiser les tests techniques et coordonner les validations fonctionnelles avant les mises en production.  * Contribuer à la gestion du cycle de vie des applications et à leur amélioration continue.   **Collaboration et accompagnement des utilisateurs*** Être un interlocuteur de référence pour les équipes métier, les équipes IT et les fournisseurs.  * Échanger avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment les professionnels de santé, les équipes administratives et les responsables informatiques des établissements.  * Vulgariser les problématiques techniques et expliquer clairement les impacts des différentes options envisagées.  * Challenger de manière constructive les demandes métier et les propositions des fournisseurs.  * Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'évolution de leurs pratiques et l'optimisation des solutions applicatives.  * Documenter les analyses, les interventions et les solutions mises en œuvre afin de favoriser le partage des connaissances et la continuité de service.   **Profil recherché** : **Formation et expérience*** Formation supérieure en informatique (HES, EPF, université ou formation jugée équivalente).  * Expérience professionnelle confirmée, idéalement d'au moins 8 à 10 ans, dans la gestion et l'évolution d'applications métier complexes.  * Parcours significatif en tant que Responsable applicatif, Product Owner, expert technico\-fonctionnel ou dans une fonction équivalente impliquant une forte responsabilité opérationnelle et technique.  * Expérience démontrée dans la résolution autonome d'incidents complexes et la gestion du cycle de vie d'applications critiques.  * Expérience dans un environnement informatique complexe, impliquant de multiples applications, interfaces, technologies et interlocuteurs.  Une expérience initiale en développement logiciel, complétée par une évolution vers la gestion applicative, constitue un parcours particulièrement intéressant. **Compétences techniques***  **Maîtrise avancée de SQL**, notamment pour les requêtes complexes, l'analyse et la manipulation de données, l'investigation d'incidents et la compréhension des procédures stockées.  * Bonne compréhension du développement applicatif, particulièrement en environnement **C\#/.NET**, avec la capacité de lire et d'analyser du code existant.  * Connaissances opérationnelles en **PowerShell et scripting**, permettant de comprendre, d'adapter ou d'automatiser certaines opérations.  * Solide compréhension des architectures applicatives, des **webservices, API et mécanismes d'intégration** entre applications.  * Bonne connaissance des environnements Windows et des interactions entre applications, serveurs, bases de données et composants techniques.  * Capacité à analyser les impacts techniques et fonctionnels des évolutions, des changements de version et des problèmes de compatibilité.  * Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité, de disponibilité, de performance et de continuité des services.   **Compétences professionnelles et qualités personnelles** Au\-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout un professionnel qui se distingue par :*  **Une excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes :** vous savez investiguer méthodiquement, identifier les causes profondes d'un dysfonctionnement et proposer des solutions pertinentes.  *  **Une forte autonomie :** vous êtes capable de prendre en charge une problématique de bout en bout, de rechercher les informations nécessaires et de mobiliser les bonnes ressources.  *  **Un réel pragmatisme :** vous savez arbitrer entre les différentes solutions possibles en tenant compte de leur valeur ajoutée, de leur coût, des délais, des risques et de leur maintenabilité.  *  **Une vision transverse :** vous comprenez les interactions entre les dimensions métier, fonctionnelles et techniques d'un système d'information.  *  **Une grande polyvalence et une forte capacité d'adaptation :** vous êtes à l'aise dans des environnements variés et savez passer rapidement d'une problématique à une autre, tout en gérant les priorités.  *  **Un excellent relationnel :**

jobs.title: Key Account Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: **Purpose of the role**  *  As a Key Account Supply Chain Manager, you will be a customer-facing supply chain expert responsible for managing relationships with assigned key accounts and supporting global account strategies.  *  You will work in a dynamic, global environment requiring strong analytical skills, agility, and a proactive mindset to drive customer satisfaction.**Responsibilities**  *  Act as the main point of contact for customers on operational supply chain topics  *  Ensure execution of defined supply chain strategies across all product lines  *  Support the Global Account Supply Chain Manager (GASCM) with analysis, scenario modeling, and business reviews  *  Create, manage, and analyze KPIs (e.g., On-Time Delivery, Lead Time, Inventory, Forecast Accuracy)  *  Provide performance insights and track improvement actions  *  Monitor supply chain performance via control tower tools to identify risks and opportunities  *  Orchestrate internal supply chain functions (planning, logistics, operations) to meet customer needs  *  Manage and execute supply chain agreements (e.g., consignment, stocking programs)  *  Act as the first point of escalation for operational supply chain issues**Qualifications:**  *  Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or similar  *  3–5 years of experience in supply chain, demand planning, or customer service within a global organization (high-tech or semiconductor industry preferred)  *  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with proven execution capability  *  Advanced Excel skills (mandatory) and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)  *  Experience with ERP systems, preferably MS Dynamics 365 (F&amp;O)  *  Solid understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes  *  Excellent communication and collaboration skills in an international environment  *  Highly customer-focused, proactive, and detail-oriented  *  Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

yields, and prevent manufacturing bottlenecks.* Identify and mitigate manufacturing risks through pFMEA, poka\-yoke (error\-proofing), and structured root\-cause investigations.### *Technical Project second\-source qualifications.* Develop qualification master plans (QMPs), coordinate project schedules and milestones, and provide transparent progress reporting to MSAT and GIN leadership.* Ensure technical alignment and effective change control between transferring and receiving supplier sites, Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs.### *Technical Supplier Management \& Operations Support** Monitor supplier manufacturing processes, technical KPIs, process stability, and component quality throughout the instrument lifecycle.* Lead technical investigations and sustainable corrective actions for component deviations and Supplier Corrective Action Requests (SCARs), using methods such as 8D, Ishikawa, and 5\-Why.* Conduct technical supplier assessments and audits to support the qualification of new and existing manufacturing partners.* Manage supplier\-side engineering changes without specification changes, capacity expansions, and continuous production line stabilization initiatives.*  **Your Profile**### *Education \& Professional Experience** University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) or Higher Technical Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, equipment.### *Technical Expertise** Proven hands\-on experience in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and testing processes.* Strong knowledge of statistical process control (SPC), jobs.description:

Head of Creative – Responsable Création Publicitaire Digitale (H/F)
======================================================================

Qui sommes\-nous ?
------------------

REA E\-Commerce est une entreprise suisse spécialisée dans le e\-commerce, propriétaire de la marque **Der Gute Fund**, qui commercialise des produits innovants pour la maison sur le marché allemand.

Notre croissance repose principalement sur la publicité digitale, notamment Meta Ads (Facebook et Instagram).

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) **Head of Creative** pour structurer et piloter notre pôle de création publicitaire, avec pour objectif de produire des publicités toujours plus performantes.

 

Votre mission
-------------

Votre mission principale sera de concevoir et mettre en place une organisation de production publicitaire efficace, structurée et évolutive.

Vous prendrez la responsabilité du pôle Création, avec pour objectif d'optimiser l'ensemble du processus, de la recherche d'idées publicitaires jusqu'à la livraison et à l'analyse des contenus.

Vous devrez combiner une solide compréhension de la publicité digitale avec d'excellentes compétences en organisation, en gestion de projets et en optimisation des processus.

 

Vos responsabilités
--------------------

### 1\. Structuration et optimisation des processus

* Concevoir, documenter et améliorer les processus de création publicitaire.
* Structurer le flux de production, de la recherche publicitaire jusqu'à la livraison des contenus.
* Mettre en place des méthodes de travail claires, standardisées et reproductibles.
* Développer des systèmes de gestion de projets, de planification et de suivi de production.
* Créer des modèles de briefs, des procédures et des standards de qualité.
* Identifier les inefficacités et mettre en place des solutions pour améliorer la productivité.
* Construire une organisation capable d'accompagner la croissance de l'entreprise et de l'équipe.


 

### 2\. Stratégie et création publicitaire digitale

* Définir et développer la stratégie créative de nos campagnes publicitaires.
* Rechercher et analyser les publicités performantes, les tendances et les opportunités créatives.
* Développer de nouveaux concepts, angles marketing, hooks et scripts publicitaires.
* Transformer les idées publicitaires en briefs précis et exploitables par l'équipe de production.
* Superviser la création de publicités vidéo, notamment les démonstrations produits et les contenus UGC.
* Analyser les performances des publicités afin d'identifier les concepts gagnants.
* Mettre en place des méthodes de tests et d'itérations pour améliorer continuellement les performances créatives.
* Utiliser les données publicitaires pour orienter les prochaines productions.


 

### 3\. Pilotage des projets et coordination de l'équipe

* Planifier, organiser et superviser les différents projets de création.
* Définir les priorités, les échéances et les livrables attendus.
* Coordonner les collaborateurs internes et les créateurs de contenus externes.
* Assurer le suivi des projets et le respect des délais.
* Contrôler la qualité des contenus produits.
* Accompagner les collaborateurs dans l'application des processus et des méthodes de travail.
* Participer au développement de l'équipe en collaboration avec la direction.


 

Votre profil
------------

### Expérience et compétences professionnelles

* Expérience confirmée en création de publicités digitales, idéalement dans le e\-commerce ou le performance marketing.
* Excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et des stratégies créatives orientées conversion.
* Expérience dans la création et l'optimisation de processus de production publicitaire.
* Solides compétences en gestion de projets, organisation et coordination d'équipes créatives.
* Capacité à analyser les performances publicitaires pour orienter la stratégie créative.
* Bonne maîtrise des formats vidéo publicitaires (UGC, démonstrations produits, hooks) et des étapes de production, du script au montage.
* Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projets et de collaboration.


### Qualités personnelles

* Vous êtes particulièrement structuré(e), méthodique et organisé(e).
* Vous aimez construire des systèmes, améliorer les méthodes de travail et résoudre les problèmes.
* Vous êtes autonome, proactif(ve) et capable de prendre des initiatives.
* Vous possédez un esprit analytique et une forte orientation vers les résultats.
* Vous savez transformer des objectifs en plans d'action concrets.
* Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement entrepreneurial en évolution.
* Vous combinez créativité, rigueur et sens des priorités.


### Ce que nous offrons

* La possibilité de prendre la responsabilité d'un pôle stratégique de notre entreprise.
* Une grande autonomie pour concevoir et mettre en place vos propres méthodes de travail.
* L'opportunité de construire des processus et une organisation durables.
* Des projets publicitaires variés, avec un impact direct sur les performances commerciales.
* Un environnement entrepreneurial dynamique, avec des décisions rapides et peu de niveaux hiérarchiques.
* La possibilité de développer progressivement le pôle Création publicitaire.
* Une collaboration directe avec la direction.


 

### Entrée en fonction : Dès que possible ou à convenir.

jobs.title: Associate Philanthropy Advisor – Private Major Donors
jobs.description: **Join MSF OCG as a Associate Philanthropy Advisor – Private Major Donors!****We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.****Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.**Inclusivity and Diversity at MSFDo your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.Context \& missionMédecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.MSF Switzerland was created in 1981 and it is headquartered in Geneva. The Philanthropy Unit is one of the eight units at the Communications and Fundraising Department. To ensure a good geographical coverage of the Swiss fundraising market, the Unit is divided into two offices: Geneva and Zurich. The Unit’s mission is to strengthen MSF’s relationship with its private major supporters, including wealthy individuals, foundations, companies, and other philanthropic organisations. It also manages grants and donations from Swiss cantons and communes. Last but not least, it is also in charge of legacy fundraising, including management of heritages as well as contacts with potential legators and confirmed bequestors.The Associate Philanthropy Advisor for private major donors in German speaking Switzerland is a key member of the Philanthropy Unit, ensuring an efficient and effective cultivation approach for private major donors in German speaking Switzerland and Liechtenstein. The mission is to secure and grow income for MSF from private major donors in German speaking Switzerland.Tasks \& Responsibilities*Strategy and action plan*Actively contribute to the implementation of the yearly plan*Cultivation and stewardship*Manages a portfolio of Major Donors and potential Top Major Donors and, alongside the Team Coordinator, design and develop the donor journey for donors giving between CHF 10’000 and CHF 20’000 annually.Regularly reports to and consults with the Team Coordinator on the strategy for the pool regarding upgrading donors within this segment.Determine the best approach and journey for each individual donor depending on their wishes and level of engagement.Prepare and facilitate one\-to\-one meetings, calls, presentations and other meaningful interactions with major donors.Interact and collaborate with key spokespersons within MSF (President, General Director, Director of Operations, other management team members), as well as field staff, with the aim of bringing donors closer to the organisation to demonstrate our life\-saving mission and work in the , propose and organise visits to MSF offices and projects, in line with MSF criteria and that the nature / identity of donors is in line with MSF gifts acceptance that the donor journey runs smoothly, and donors are thanked and stewarded the database is kept engaging communication for the MDs about MSF projects.*Solicitation/ask*In line with the yearly plan and past giving history of main donors, proactively present asks to selected donors for gifts (general and individualized asks) and consult with the Team Coordinator about the solicitation planEnsure that the major donors journey strategy is followed and that major donors are solicited according to their motivations in a personalised way.

jobs.title: Junior Technical Procurement Specialist
jobs.description: Your missionIn this role, you will support procurement and supply chain activities to help ensure the timely availability of materials required for production and development. Working closely with experienced colleagues across Engineering, Production, and Operations, you will gain exposure to sourcing, supplier coordination, inventory management, negotiation, and purchasing processes while developing your procurement expertise in a high-tech manufacturing environment.Your profileKey Responsibilities*Support day-to-day purchasing activities, including purchase order creation, supplier communication, and order tracking.*Assist with sourcing activities for production and development projects under the guidance of experienced team members.*Help maintain material availability and inventory accuracy by monitoring stock levels and following up on deliveries.*Support supplier onboarding, qualification, and documentation processes.*Assist with incoming quality inspections and coordinate follow-up actions with suppliers when required.*Maintain procurement, supplier, and inventory data within the ERP system.*Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to purchasing, inventory management, and operational processes.*Support supplier performance monitoring by collecting and maintaining relevant KPI data.*Collaborate with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure smooth material flow and timely issue resolution.*Contribute to developing and documenting procurement procedures and work instructions.Skills & Experience*Technical apprenticeship, vocational training, HF degree, Bachelor's degree, or equivalent education in a technical field.*0-5 years of professional experience in procurement, operations, production, logistics, supply chain, or a related technical environment.*Interest in purchasing, supply chain management, and supplier relationships.*Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.*Comfortable working with Excel and ERP systems; experience with Odoo is an advantage but not required.*Good communication skills and a collaborative working style.*Ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed.*Interest in learning about quality management, supplier management, and manufacturing processes.*Interest in negotiation. Languages*Fluent English & German required Terms of Employment*Workload: 80-100%; maximum 20% travel (visiting suppliers)*Working arrangements: On-site*Location: Headquarters in Stettbach near Zurich, Switzerland*Preferred start date: ASAP ContactIn this role, you will play an important part in supporting the efficient operation of our supply chain and procurement activities. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, develop your technical and commercial skills, and gain broad exposure to purchasing, supplier management, inventory control, and operational processes within a growing Swiss technology company. Please submit your application by email only. Include your CV and a cover letter in English explaining why you are an excellent fit for this role. We look forward to receiving your application! Applications submitted by headhunters or third parties will not be consideredWhy us?You will be joining a fast-growing scale-up in our beautiful new office in Stettbach. Our international team values excellence, collaboration, and integrity. jobs.title: Kinderbetreuer/-in 100%
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kinderbetreuer/-in 100% (w/m/i)---Kinderbetreuer/\-in 100% (w/m/i)================================unbefristetKinderbetreuer/\-in 100% (w/m/i)================================unbefristet  Eine Ikone der Schweizer Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.    Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.    Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung eine/n  * Sie führen selbständig die Kinderbetreuung auf dem Bürgenstock und gestalten für unsere kleinen Gäste aus der ganzen Welt ein spannendes Programm* Sie organisieren und planen die Aktivitäten individuell nach den Wünschen der Eltern und Kindern* Beraten und Informieren über unsere Kids Club Dienstleistungen und Angebote* Betreuung und Animation der Kinder und Jugendlichen* Abwicklung und Dokumentation der Gästebetreuung* Vorbereitung und Mithilfe des wöchentlichen abwechslungsreichen Programm* Aufräumen und Reinigen der Räumlichkeiten sowie die aktive Mithilfe im Alpine SpaSie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachfrau/\-mann Betreuung EFZ oder haben mindestens 3\-4 Jahre Erfahrung als Kinderbetreuerin in Kindertagesstätten oder ähnlichen Einrichtungen. An Wochenenden und Feiertagen unterhalten Sie die Kinder im Kids Club genauso wie an allen Wochentagen und sind flexible die Wünsche unseren kleinen Gästen in deren Eltern nachzukommen. Ein hohes Mass an Verantwortung, Interesse an Musik und Tanz sowie Deutsch, Englisch und allenfalls weitere Sprachkenntnisse qualifizieren Sie ebenso für diese spannende Position, wie die Freude mit Kindern zu arbeiten.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.     Auszeichnungen:   *Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»  Travel \+ Leisure «500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel*»*  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»       BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Koch  HR Assistant  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon*    ******jid6a6f92ejm jit1145jm jiy26jm

At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your Role

As (Senior) Analyst at Statista R, you will join our international team of data professionals, supporting the analytical backbone of Statista’s ranking business at Statista R.

Your work will focus on analyzing quantitative data, defining analytical models together with the topic experts and managing data driven ranking projects and products primarily around the education space.

Your work will include the collection, validation, and analysis of data that powers our Rankings, Ratings, and Benchmarking projects. Moreover, you will support the development of new, data-driven products.

In being the data structure and analytics backbone of the team, you will work closely with different project teams as well as cross divisional teams to improve data handling processes and strategic alignment with departmental goals. Hereby, you always consider new AI capabilities to improve efficiency in the team.

Your work will directly support Statista’s mission to make excellence measurable, comparable, and actionable - globally.

 

Your Tasks

  • Support in maintaining and further developing Statista’s rankings and data products, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and scalability

  • Support in building and the internal database structure in alignment with cross-departmental teams

  • Collaborate on and manage rankings and benchmarking projects - from design over data handling to scoring and results analysis

  • Develop and document data models and scoring frameworks in alignment with current academic research in cooperation with the analyst team

  • Support the team in ensuring data transparency and quality as well as alignment with reporting standards through data structures

  • Support in assessing and identifying data needs

  • Actively contribute ideas for new data-driven education products and improvement of existing workflows

  • Experience working with decision makers and delivering actionable, data-driven insights

  • Understanding of AI trends and good knowledge of relevant tools

  • Fluent in English, German or other languages a plus

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to transform complex data into actionable insights

jobs.title: Founding Legal Engineer
jobs.description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.


About the role

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

Working directly with Grubel’s founding team, you will shape our research, development, and product: Translate complex legal processes into agentic workflows, evaluate our systems for legal soundness and utility, and work with customers to set our product and engineering standards. You need not write code, but you’re passionate about understanding our technology deeply. Working in a fast-moving team at the intersection of AI research, legal practice, and technology excites you.

What you’ll work on

  • Designing realistic tasks, datasets, and evaluation rubrics for training and evaluation of our legal AI systems

  • Translating complex legal processes into agentic workflows together with our researchers and engineers

  • Evaluating system outputs for legal accuracy, usefulness, and failure modes

  • Leading enterprise pilots and implementations

  • Supporting customer discovery, demonstrations, and go-to-market initiatives

You may be a good fit if

  • You have law degree and strong academic record

  • You have experience practicing law—whether at a law firm, in-house, or in another legal setting

  • You are proactive, self-directed, and comfortable taking broad ownership at an early-stage company

  • You are curious about how AI systems work and comfortable working closely with researchers and engineers

Logistics

  • Munich or Tübingen. We value working together in person, prefer candidates based near one of our offices, and expect at least one day per week in the office. We plan to establish a Zurich office in 2027.

  • Full time employment

  • Competitive salary plus a stock option grant in Grubel, Inc., our US parent company.

jobs.title: Founding Enterprise BDR | France
jobs.description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. The product is real; the French playbook is still being written. We are outsiders here, and we will earn our place through better conversations, sharper execution, and customers who see the difference.

We are outbound first. As our founding BDR in France, you will start conversations rather than wait for them. You will find the right companies, reach the people who own customer operations, and create qualified opportunities for the team. You will also help decide which messages, channels, and routines deserve to become our French sales playbook.

What you'll do

  • Build targeted account lists and find the people with a real customer interaction problem to solve.

  • Prospect every day through calls, email, LinkedIn, and thoughtful experiments. The phone is a core part of this role.

  • Run sharp first conversations: understand the workflow, volume, owner, urgency, and reason to act; then hand over opportunities with context the AE can use.

  • Test messages and sequences, measure what turns into useful conversations and qualified pipeline, and improve quickly.

  • Bring what prospects say back to the France team, product, and marketing, and use those insights to improve targeting and messaging.

What makes you a great fit

  • You do not need sales experience. Your background could be the military, firefighting, competitive sport, or something else entirely. What matters is your discipline, coachability, rigor, and ability to keep going through rejection.

  • You speak clearly, listen closely, are curious about how businesses work, and are willing to learn a technical product. You are comfortable picking up the phone.

  • You care about the quality of the opportunity, not just the number of meetings on a calendar.

  • You take feedback directly, own your results, and keep moving when the answer is no.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You speak and write excellent French, work comfortably in English, are based in Paris, and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You need inbound leads, a finished script, or detailed direction before you can start.

  • You avoid the phone or repeated outreach.

  • You resist coaching or let a string of no's stop you from trying a better approach.

  • You value meeting counts over understanding whether a prospect has a real problem and reason to act.

The reality of the role

You will be one of the first people building telli's presence in France. There is no mature local demand engine or perfect script to inherit. Outbound is the core of this role, and some ideas will fail. You will make a lot of calls, learn fast, and help turn an early market into a repeatable business. If that sounds like the best challenge of your career, we want to meet you.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you open doors. Show us how you prepare, earn a first conversation, ask and listen, follow up, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the discipline and judgment you would bring to building pipeline in France.

Compensation

€60,000–€80,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

jobs.description:
Deine Rolle

Mittelständische Unternehmer erleben Beratungen meist in einer austauschbaren Eventsprache: Konferenzhotel, Standard-Catering, ein Programm, das in jedem Raum gleich aussieht. Genau dort liegt der Hebel für ein anderes Modell, über alle Anlassgrößen vom Webinar bis zur eigenen Konferenz.

Vogel berät mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen in steuerlichen, kaufmännischen und strategischen Fragen. Für dieses Netzwerk bauen wir die Event-Infrastruktur auf: Roundtables, Retreats, Salon-Formate, individuelle Mandanten-Dinner, eine laufende Webinar-Reihe, ausgewählte Messeauftritte und perspektivisch eine eigene Mittelstandskonferenz. Auch unsere internen Anlässe wie Town Hall, Sommerfest und Off-sites sollen sich anfühlen wie Vogel und nicht wie ein Standard-Firmenfest.

Du kommst aus der Premium-Hospitality, aus einem gehobenen Restaurant oder von einer Event-Marke mit hohem Anspruch und willst Formate selbst entwerfen, statt fertige Konzepte umzusetzen. Du verantwortest die Event- und Brand-Experience von Vogel, arbeitest im Growth-Team und eng mit der Geschäftsführung an ausgewählten Formaten. Nach 24 bis 36 Monaten führt der natürliche Weg in eine Lead-Rolle für Event und Brand Experience.

Deine Verantwortung

Flagship-Anlässe und individuelle Formate

  • Du entwirfst die Format-Bibliothek von Vogel, vom Salon über das kuratierte Dinner bis zum Retreat, und trägst jeden Anlass vom Konzept bis zum letzten Detail.

  • Du baust die eigene Mittelstandskonferenz mit auf: Bühne, Programm, Catering, Eingangserlebnis.

  • Du verantwortest Formate im kleinen Kreis: Mandanten-Dinner nach Branche, persönliche Termine mit Multiplikatoren, Salons mit wenigen Gästen.

Laufender Betrieb: Webinare, interne Anlässe, Messen

  • Du koordinierst die Webinar-Reihe mit zwei bis drei Terminen pro Woche: Technik, Ablaufplan, Nachbereitung und Nachverfolgung im CRM. Die Berater halten die Inhalte, du hältst den Standard.

  • Du verantwortest den Rahmen unserer internen Anlässe auf demselben Detail-Standard wie nach außen.

  • Du steuerst unsere Präsenz auf ausgewählten Messen, vom Standkonzept bis zum Auftritt vor Ort.

Markenstandard und Abläufe

  • Du hältst jeden Anlass gegen unser Stylebook: warme Tischkultur, reduzierte Gestaltung, echte Materialien.

  • Du pflegst die Gästelisten mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Business Development: kuratiert, nicht im Massenversand.

  • Du dokumentierst wiederverwendbare Standards, vom Eingangsritual bis zum Webinar-Ablauf, damit sie ohne dich tragen.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast die ersten Roundtables und Retreats eigenständig getragen und parallel die Webinar-Reihe übernommen.

  • Du hast eine eigene Format-Bibliothek aufgebaut: Flagship-Formate, Webinar-Ablauf, Playbook für interne Anlässe.

Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du trägst fünfzehn bis zwanzig Flagship-Anlässe im Jahr und die laufende Webinar-Reihe eigenständig.

  • Die internen Anlässe laufen auf demselben Standard wie die Formate für Mandanten.

Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Die eigene Mittelstandskonferenz ist gelaufen und hat einen Ruf über unsere Mandanten hinaus.

  • Du bist Kandidat für die Lead-Rolle Event und Brand Experience.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Der nächste Schritt ist die Lead-Rolle für Event und Brand Experience. Sie setzt eine eigenständig getragene Event-Architektur und sichtbare Format-Reputation voraus, nicht zusätzliche Berufsjahre.

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Belegbare Praxis in der Premium-Hospitality: in einer Hotelmarke mit hohem Service-Anspruch, einem gehobenen Restaurant oder bei einer Event-Marke für anspruchsvolle Gäste.

  • Du hast neben Flagship-Anlässen auch den laufenden Betrieb in hoher Frequenz verantwortet, mit demselben Detail-Standard.

  • Profile, die nicht in dieses Raster passen, aber Format-Gespür und Sinn für Details mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen. Konkret: Innenarchitekten mit Praxis im Eventbau, Producer aus Magazinen mit Live-Formaten, Quereinsteiger aus Theater oder Oper. Wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala: Das untere Ende steht für belegbare Praxis in der Premium-Hospitality, das obere Ende für eigene Format-Architektur und einen erkennbaren Methodenbeitrag. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du hast Gespür für Details: Im Catering-Briefing, im Lichtkonzept oder in der Bestuhlung erkennst du, was trägt und was kippt.

  • Du beherrschst Webinar-Werkzeuge und Ablaufplanung und löst operative Engpässe selbst, statt sie zu eskalieren.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI als selbstverständlichem Werkzeug für Recherche, Einladungstexte und Ablaufpläne.

Mindset & Persönlichkeit

  • Du hast den Anspruch, in allem, was du ablieferst, den höchsten Standard zu setzen, nicht weil jemand es kontrolliert, sondern weil Mittelmaß dich persönlich stört.

  • Du bringst die Demut mit, von Praktikern zu lernen. Mandanten und Berater wissen Dinge über den Mittelstand, die in keinem Hospitality-Handbuch stehen.

  • Du fühlst dich wohl in einer Kultur, die hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist.

Was du bei uns nicht finden wirst

  • Keinen Event-Job mit ausgelagerter Logistik. Du machst Konzept und Umsetzung zugleich.

  • Kein reines Webinar-Marketing. Du verantwortest das ganze Erlebnis über alle Anlassgrößen.

  • Keinen Agentur-Hochglanz. Wir arbeiten in kurzen Zyklen, in kleinen Teams und schrauben selbst am Detail.

  • Keinen Aufstieg über Personalspanne. Du wächst über fachliche Tiefe.

FAQ

1. Was ist Vogel – und wo arbeitet ihr?

Vogel ist eine der führenden Mittelstandsberatungen Deutschlands – seit 1959, inhabergeführt in zweiter Generation, mit eigenem Kapital – und baut daraus die führende Beratungsplattform für den Mittelstand. Wir arbeiten an drei Standorten: Aalen als gewachsenem Stammsitz, Bopfingen im Kerngeschäft und München als neuem Hub. An allen dreien suchen wir quer durch die Funktionen – von Steuerberatung über Beratung bis zu den Teams, die das Fundament darunter bauen.

2. Wie sind die Gehaltsbänder zu verstehen?

Bewusst breit – und an jeder Stelle ausgewiesen, bevor du dich bewirbst. Wir differenzieren nach Track Record und Marktwert, nicht nach Abschluss: knappe, stark gefragte Profile am oberen Ende, weniger knappe am unteren. Die ausgewiesene Spanne ist kein Verhandlungsspielraum, sondern eine Profil-Skala – zwei Menschen mit ähnlicher Erfahrung können bei uns unterschiedlich verdienen. Was das obere Ende bestimmt, ist der Reifegrad, nicht die Zahl der Berufsjahre und nicht das Verhandlungsgeschick.

3. Wie viel – und wie – wird bei Vogel gearbeitet?

Gemessen wird an dem, was du bewegst, nicht an Stunden. Ehrlich ist aber auch: Wer 9-to-5 sucht, ist bei uns nicht die erste Adresse. Wir suchen Menschen, die aus eigenem Antrieb intensiv arbeiten, weil die Aufgaben es wert sind. Wie du deine Zeit verteilst, ist weitgehend deine Sache. Was wir teilen: Wir arbeiten präsent zusammen und sehen uns im Normalfall täglich im Büro – Kultur, Sparring und die besten Ideen entstehen in der täglichen Nähe. Wir sind keine Remote-Company und haben keine großen Home-Office-Policies; einzelne Remote-Tage sind kein Problem.

4. Wie läuft die Bewerbung?

Schlank, schnell, transparent – und nach Profil gestaffelt. In der Regel sind es vier Schritte: eine schriftliche Aufgabe, in der du zu acht Fragen Position beziehst – KI ist ausdrücklich erlaubt, wir bitten nur um eine kurze Selbstauskunft dazu; ein Gespräch von einer halben Stunde; eine gemeinsame Arbeitssitzung an einem echten Problem aus unserem Alltag; und ein Termin vor Ort mit dem Team und gemeinsamem Essen. Wie viele Schritte es tatsächlich werden, hängt von der Rolle ab: Bei Praktikum und Werkstudium fällt der Vor-Ort-Termin weg, für Schülerjobs genügt ein Gespräch, bei Senior-Rollen kommt ein gemeinsamer Arbeitsnachmittag dazu. Vorab kannst du einen Zehn-Minuten-Call buchen, in dem nur du fragst. In der Regel hörst du nach jedem Schritt innerhalb von 48 Stunden von uns.

5. Wie funktioniert die variable Vergütung?

Quartalsweise an Leistung gekoppelt, qualitativ bewertet. Die Skala steigt mit dem Level: bis 20 % Associate, 27,5 % Manager, 35 % Senior Manager, 42,5 % Director, 50 % VP. Erwartungswert bei guter Leistung – du erfüllst die Anforderungen, setzt eigene Akzente, bestehst den Keeper Test – liegt bei rund 50 % des Maximums; der Maximalbonus ist nicht der Normalfall. Im Fokus steht eine ganzheitliche Beurteilung durch deine Führungskraft anhand von sechs Kriterien: Impact, Judgement, Communication, Execution, Growth und Values.

6. Wie entwickle ich mich – welche Karrierewege gibt es?

Zwei aktive Wege: die IC-Karriere (fachliche Tiefe, Expertenlaufbahn) über die Stufen Expert, Senior, Lead und Principal – und die Management-Karriere (Führung, Personalverantwortung) über Manager, Senior Manager, Director und VP. Beide werden gleich vergütet, und beide müssen nicht nach oben führen: Wer auf einer Stufe bleibt und dort weiter in die Tiefe geht, ist bei uns genauso richtig. Die Richtung wählst du nach dem Onboarding, meist in Jahr 1–3. Berufseinstieg ist kein Sonderweg, sondern der frühe Teil derselben Strecke – vom Werkstudenten oder Praktikanten zum Associate, für die Besten ohne erneutes Bewerbungsverfahren.

7. Team, Kultur, Urlaub?

Das gemeinsame Mittagessen ist der tägliche Ankerpunkt – wer im Büro ist, isst mit; erwartet, nicht kontrolliert. Das Abendessen ist dasselbe Angebot ohne jede Erwartung. Beides ohne Eigenanteil. Dazu Social Events und Offsites in regelmäßigem Rhythmus – nicht als Pflichtprogramm, sondern weil ein gutes Team auch abseits der Arbeit Zeit teilt.

Benefits sind bei uns nicht das Sahnehäubchen, sondern das, was Intensität über Jahre tragbar macht: Examensförderung mit 25.000 EUR Qualifizierungsbudget und drei Monaten Freistellung, 100-prozentige Übernahme der Kinderbetreuung, EGYM Wellpass, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Job-Ticket mit 90 % Zuschuss, Homeoffice-Ausstattung und ein Gerät deiner Wahl aus unserem Katalog, ein Buch im Monat aus dem Vogel-Kanon – und KI-Tools ohne Token-Limit und ohne Budgetdeckel. Urlaub: 28 Tage.

  • Du schreibst sauberen Code in mindestens einer Sprache, idealerweise Python oder TypeScript, und kennst SQL.
