jobs.title: Resepsjonst Sesong
jobs.description:
Vil du være med og sette standarden for gjesteopplevelser på Nord-Norges største hotell?

Vi søker en serviceorientert resepsjonist i sesong som ønsker å være en del av resepsjonen på The Dock 69°39 by Scandic. Hotellet åpnet i juni 2025 og representerer en unik kombinasjon av arktisk eleganse, historie og moderne komfort. Dette er en sjelden mulighet til å ta del i en resepsjonsavdeling som blir hotellets pulserende hjerte.

Arbeidstiden varerierer mellom vakter på dag- og kveldstid, samt fast annenhver helg, lørdag og søndag. Oppstart etter avtale, men senest innen midten av desember. Jobb i julen må påregnes.

Dette er en 100% stilling i sesong ut mars 2027. Mulighet for forlengelse.

Om hotelletThe Dock 69°39 by Scandic ligger i Vervet, Tromsøs historiske og urbane bydel, hvor kulturarv møter internasjonal puls. Hotellet strekker seg over 12 etasjer med 305 elegante rom, inkludert moderne suiter med spektakulær utsikt over fjord, fjell og by. På toppen av hotellet finner du vår eksklusive à la carte-restaurant med arktiske råvarer og spektakulær utsikt. På bakkeplan inviterer levende fellesområder både lokale og reisende til å samles for nordnorsk gjestfrihet.

Din rolle som resepsjonistSom resepsjonist vil du ha ansvaret for hotellets resepsjon – hotellets første og viktigste møtepunkt for gjestene våre. Din lidenskap for service og øye for detaljer vil sikre at vi skaper uforglemmelige opplevelser for alle som besøker oss. Du - og resten av resepsjonsteamet, speiler hotellets standard for kvalitet, profesjonalitet og varme. I dine arbeidsoppgaver som resepsjonist, vil du blant annet gjøre:

  • Inn og utsjekking av våre gjester i vårt hotellsystem Opera Cloud
  • Koordinere med alle avdelinger for å oppfylle våre gjesters ønsker og behov
  • Bidra til mersalg
  • Ta del i og aktivt arbeide med avdelingsmålene
  • Ta imot bookinger og hente fakturaer
  • Svare på spørsmål fra våre gjester, både elektronisk og over skranke
  • Kassehåndtering
  • Utstrakt samarbeid mellom alle avdelingene på hotellet

Hvem er du?Vi ser etter en entusiastisk, strukturert og detaljorientert medarbeider som trives i et dynamisk miljø. Du har solid erfaring fra lignende stillinger, og du brenner for å levere serviceopplevelser i verdensklasse. Videre ønsker vi at du:

  • Har erfaring fra servicebransjen
  • Snakker et av de skandinaviske språkene og engelsk flytende
  • Er serviceinnstilt og opptatt av å skape gode opplevelser for både gjester og ansatte
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert, med evne til å takle utfordringer med kreativitet og ro

Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?På The Dock 69°39 by Scandic vil du få muligheten til å jobbe på Nord-Norges største hotell, som setter standarden for kvalitet, innovasjon og gjestfrihet. Vi tilbyr:

  • En sjelden mulighet til å delta i noe helt unikt fra starten
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Et dynamisk arbeidsmiljø der samarbeid og trivsel står i fokus

I Scandic jobber vi hver dag for å få med flere, og for å være det mest inkluderende selskapet. Er du klar til å skape magi på Nord-Norges største og flotteste hotell?

Søk hos oss!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hvorfor nøye seg med det ordinære, når du kan forvandle hvert øyeblikk av ditt arktiske eventyr til en opplevelse? Velkommen til The Dock 69°39, et unikt signaturhotell i hjertet av Tromsø. Her, i byen kjent for sine eksotiske værfenomener som midnattssol, nordlys og alt imellom, kan du utforske Arktis på dine premisser, uten å velge bort eksklusiv komfort. Inspirert av områdets kulturarv og historie som skipsverft, er hotellet designet som et samlingspunkt for tilreisende og lokale som vil oppleve det beste Tromsø har å by på. Bygget er et ikonisk landemerke, plassert like ved vannkanten med 13 etasjer og 305 harmoniske rom. Rommene er inspirert av kulturen til arktiske eventyrere før og nå. De er designet for å skape et moderne varmt miljø, noe som gjør dem til et komfortabelt og trygt utgangspunkt fra der dine arktiske opplevelser begynner

jobs.title: FRA HVERDAGSRUTINER TIL NYE EVENTYR.

jobs.description:
Liker du en aktiv arbeidshverdag som gir variasjon, frisk luft og praktiske oppgaver, kan dette være en jobb for deg.

Jeg er en kvinne i 40-årene som gradvis har mistet synet mitt. Nå ønsker jeg mer hjelp i hverdagen for at jeg fortsatt kan være aktiv, engasjert og selvstendig i mine gjøremål.

Noen dager handler det om å lage middag, gjøre æren og få litt orden hjemme, mens andre dager er det trening og aktivitet som gjelder. Da lar vi humør og vær bestemme om det blir tur i skogen med matpakke, løping, klatring, ski eller styrketrening. Jeg er åpen for å prøve nye aktiviter, eller få med meg en konsert innimellom. Av og til vil det være behov for å være med som ledsager på besøk hos andre, reiser eller ulike arrangementer.

Jeg bor sammen med ektefelle, to barn i småskolealder og en hund. Arbeidsplassen din vil derfor også være hjemmet til vår familie. Vi liker å bli kjent med nye mennesker, og ønsker at det skal være en god ramme for å løse arbeidsoppgavene. Det innebærer først og fremst å tilrettelegge for at det blir god flyt i hverdagen vår, og synstolke omgivelsene for meg ved behov. Grundig opplæring blir gitt, og det er ikke nødvendig med forkunnskaper.

Jeg ser etter deg som:
  • Er praktisk anlagt og har god ordenssans
  • Liker å være sammen med barn
  • Er pålitelig og omgjengelig
  • Har god observasjonsevne og kan formidle det du ser
  • Liker fysisk aktivitet og trening
  • Har førerkort klasse B
Arbeidstid

Arbeidstid kan i noe grad tilpasses, men det er ønskelig at du kan jobbe:

  • Fast én ettermiddag per uke, i tidsrommet kl. 14.00-19.00.
  • Fleksible vakter på ca. 4 timer, 2-4 ganger i måneden
  • Mulighet for tilkallingsvakter av kortere og lengre varighet

På grunn av stillingens natur oppfordres kvinner til å søke.

Høres dette ut som en jobb for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!*

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. jobs.title: Commercial Director – Defence and Security
jobs.description:
Much of the energy and data Europe depends on travels through cables and pipelines on the seabed. Securing this infrastructure, along with offshore installations, has become a clear priority for defence. DeepOcean has more than 25 years of experience in subsea survey, installation, trenching, inspection, maintenance and repair. We are now setting up a separate defence and security team to offer these services to defence organisations in Norway, the UK, NATO and allied countries.

We are looking for a Commercial Director to lead our sales and bid work in this market. As the team is newly established, you will be starting from scratch.  You will decide which customers to focus on, build the relationships and lead the bids through to signed contracts. You will report to the Director of the DeepOcean defence team and join a small team with real freedom to shape how the business develops. You will need to be hands-on yourself and gradually build the team required to handle the growth in the unit.

The role is based in Norway and involves regular travel to customers, partners and our sites in Norway, the UK and internationally. Applications will be handled confidentially.  

Your key responsibilities:

  • Map the defence market and build our pipeline – Norwegian Armed Forces and Forsvarsmateriell, NATO and NATO agencies, UK MOD and the Royal Navy, allied nations and the major defence primes – and decide where we can realistically win.
  • Build and maintain the relationships that give us access, from programme owners and capability planners to partners and primes, and put the teaming agreements and partnerships in place that let us compete.
  • Lead capture and bids end to end: the bid/no-bid call, the win strategy, shaping the solution with our engineers and operators, pricing it, writing it, submitting it and defending it.
  • Secure our licence to bid – supplier registrations, prequalifications, frameworks and the compliance groundwork a new defence entity needs before anyone will take its offer seriously.
  • Negotiate terms and commercial risk through to contract, then hand the work over cleanly to the delivery organisation.
  • Build the commercial function itself – pipeline reporting, bid process, win/loss discipline – and grow a small commercial and bid team as the business scales.

 

Experience and qualifications:

  • 7–10 years in business development, capture or commercial roles, with significant time spent selling into or working within defence.
  • An active, current network in Norwegian defence (Forsvaret, Forsvarsmateriell, FFI) and/or NATO, UK MOD or allied defence organisations.
  • Practical experience of public and defence procurement – tender requirements, framework competitions, evaluation criteria – and of negotiating commercial terms and risk.
  • A degree in engineering, business or economics, or a military academy background. Strong, directly relevant experience can replace formal qualifications.
  • Eligible for Norwegian and NATO security clearance. You do not need to hold a clearance today – but should be able to receive a clearance when needed.
  • A background in subsea, maritime, offshore or naval work is an advantage.

 

Personal qualifications:

  • You are a self-starter who is comfortable without a playbook, and you would rather build the function than inherit it.
  • You have commercial judgement and the nerve to use it – you know which opportunities to walk away from, and you can make that case internally.
  • You write well and present well, and you hold your own in front of senior military and industry people.
  • You play the long game when it comes to relationships, in a market where decisions can take years.
  • You are resilient and organised, and you can run several bids to fixed deadlines without dropping any of them.
  • You are curious about the technology, enough to explain to a customer what our capability actually does for them.

Our values are important to us, and we are therefore looking for people who identify with them: We ACT with a can-do Attitude. We ACT with the Courage to embrace new challenges, stop unsafe practices, always be compliant and shift boundaries through innovative solutions. And we ACT as one Team.

 

Why will you enjoy working with us?

  • A fast-paced and team-oriented work environment – we have fun at work!
  • Varied challenges, great development opportunities, and the chance to make an impact in a global organization.
  • Favorable travel insurance (including family members), health insurance, and pension plans (including AFP), as well as subsidies for physical activity.
  • Flexible working hours and a strong focus on work-life balance, so you can thrive both at work and at home.
  • And for this role in particular: a rare opportunity to build a new business from the ground up, with the resources, track record and engineering depth of an established international subsea company behind you.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and workplace. We value inclusion, equality and diversity and encourage all qualified candidates to apply.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

DeepOcean is a technology-driven, independent solution provider in the ocean space. We offer companies within oil and gas, offshore renewables, deep sea minerals, and other non-energy niches a full range of services – from surveys, engineering, project management and installation to maintenance and recycling.

Our global team of experts is at the forefront of remote and unmanned operations and digitally-enabled services. Supported by an extensive tool and technology pool, they drive cost-efficient, safe and sustainable operations. DeepOcean has a GO GREEN attitude, continuously looking to make our customers’ operations more sustainable, through reducing both carbon footprint and costs.  

A world-leading ocean services provider, DeepOcean enables the energy transition and sustainable use of ocean resources. People are the heart of our operations. It’s about technology, systems, and processes, but in the end, it is our people that deliver the services.

Linnea & Basilika is looking for 4 skilled, dedicated, and responsible chefs to join our restaurant at Hyldgårdvej 11, 7500 Holstebro, Denmark.

We are looking for passionate individuals who enjoy cooking, appreciate high-quality ingredients, and take pride in creating excellent dining experiences.

At Linnea & Basilika, we value teamwork, professionalism, efficiency, and a positive working environment. You will become part of an international kitchen team where cooperation and quality are essential to our daily operations.

Your Responsibilities

As a chef at Linnea & Basilika, you will play an important role in our daily kitchen operations.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing and cooking dishes according to restaurant standards

  • Preparing ingredients and organizing daily food production

  • Ensuring consistent food quality, taste, and presentation

  • Maintaining high standards of hygiene and food safety

  • Handling and storing ingredients correctly

  • Keeping kitchen workstations clean and organized

  • Working closely with other chefs and restaurant staff

  • Supporting smooth and efficient kitchen operations

  • Maintaining quality and efficiency during busy service periods

  • Contributing to a positive and professional working environment

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have previous experience working as a chef or professional cook

  • Preferably have experience with Asian cuisine

  • Are passionate about cooking and food quality

  • Can work independently and as part of a team

  • Are reliable, responsible, and flexible

  • Can work efficiently in a busy restaurant environment

  • Have good knowledge of kitchen hygiene and food safety

  • Are willing to work weekdays, evenings, and weekends

  • Have a positive attitude and good teamwork skills

Formal culinary qualifications are an advantage but not essential if you have relevant practical kitchen experience.

  • Opportunities for professional development

Linnea & BasilikaHyldgårdvej 117500 HolstebroDenmark

Toimialaosaaminen tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen ja vastuun laajentamiseen tulevaisuudessa.Mitä työ pitää sisällään?- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissäMitä tarjoamme sinulle?- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan sekä ihmisiin, asiakkaisiin että toiminnan kehittämiseen- Mahdollisuuden kasvattaa omaa vastuutasi ja osaamistasi tehtävän mukana- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön sekä hallinnon palvelutiimien tuen- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista- Joustavat työskentelytavat ja työajat sekä mahdollisuuden hybridityöhön- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta- Ymmärrät taloushallinnon toimintaympäristöä ja asiantuntijatyön arkea- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja saat muut innostumaan ja onnistumaan- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä niin tiimin kuin asiakkaidenkin kanssa- Haluat aidosti kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäinTehtävässä eduksi katsotaan- Matkailualan liiketoiminnan tai alan yritysten taloushallinnon tuntemus. Se on tehtävässä hyödyksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseenToimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.Kiinnostuitko? jobs.title: Sprudlende og glad jente på 14 år søker leken og sporty BPA-assistent
jobs.description:
Hvem skal du jobbe med?

Jeg er en glad, leken og livlig 14 år gammel jente med glimt i øyet, som trenger assistanse i det daglige for å kunne leve et så godt liv som mulig. Jeg elsker å være ute, hoppe trampoline, gå tur, være i svømmehallen, på lekeplass eller å sykle. Jeg har både tandemsykkel og lastesykkel. På vinteren liker jeg å gå på ski og ake. Nå søker jeg en lekevenn som kan bli med meg på disse aktivitetene og motivere meg til å ta gode valg når jeg blir litt sta eller temperamentsfull.

Jeg bor på Jar i Bærum sammen med mamma, pappa, storesøsteren min og hunden vår. Du må derfor trives med hund.

Hvem er du?

Ser etter deg som liker å gå på turer, være ute, er leken og sporty og som liker å jobbe med mennesker. Du har godt humør, er pliktoppfyllende, tålmodig og ærlig. Du må ta initiativ og finne på ting selv.Vi er fleksible og håper at dette kan gå begge veier.

  • Må være positiv, sporty og samarbeidsvillig

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Ikke allergisk mot hund

  • Selvstendig og utadvendt

  • Fleksibel på arbeidstid, og det er en fordel om du bor i nærheten

Jeg verdsetter mangfold og oppfordrer alle som kjenner seg igjen i beskrivelsen til å søke.

Hvordan vil din arbeidshverdag se ut?

  • Ta meg imot når jeg kommer hjem fra skolen

  • kjøre tilfritidsaktivitet

  • Enkel matlaging

  • Støvsuge og gjelpe meg å rydde rommet mitt

  • Være med på svømming og turn

  • Personlig hygiene og kveldsstell

Arbeidstid

Jeg trenger asistenter på ettermiddagen, primært mandag til fredag fra 16.00-19.00/20.00, samt noen kvelder og helger, i alt fra 20%-50% stilling. Spesifiser i søknaden hvor stor stilling du ønsker deg.

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Underviser til FVU-start, FVU-dansk og ordblindeundervisning ved LOF Midtjylland

Vi søger en underviser til FVU-start, FVU-dansk og ordblindeundervisning med tiltrædelse januar 2027.

Stillingen kan evt. kombineres med undervisning i andre FVU-fag, og kan alt efter kompetencer sammensættes herefter. Ansættelsen vil i første omgang være som timelærer på deltid.

Som underviser i LOF Midtjylland vil du indgå i et lærerteam af engagerede FVU- og ordblindeundervisere, som arbejder med faglig stolthed. I det daglige arbejdes der selvstændigt, og når man mødes, udveksles der erfaringer i et tillidsfuldt samarbejde. Vi deltager i konferencer og udvikler løbende på vores undervisning i henhold til bekendtgørelser og undervisningsplaner.

Vi underviser på flere forskellige undervisningssteder, og jobbet kræver derfor selvstændighed og mobilitet.

jobs.title: Raskaskoneasentaja, Kankaanpää
jobs.description: Raskaan kaluston asentaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Etsitkö vakaata työpaikkaa, jossa on reilu meininki, mahdollisuus kehittyä ja osaamista arvostava palkkaus?Asiakkaamme on pitkään toiminut ja hyvämaineinen huoltokorjaamo, joka etsii nyt tiimiinsä kokoaikaista ja vakituista raskaan kaluston asentajaa. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti kuorma-autojen, perävaunujen ja erilaisten työkoneiden parissa. Työskentelet pääasiassa arkipäivisin klo 7.00–17.30 välillä. Toivomme kuitenkin joustavuutta, sillä työpäivien pituudet saattavat vaihdella työtilanteen mukaan. Tulevaisuudessa yrityksessä on mahdollista siirtyä 2-vuorotyöhön, ja toisinaan töitä tehdään myös viikonloppuisin. Saat vahvan tuen ja perusteellisen perehdytyksen – meillä kaveria ei jätetä yksin. Palkkaus määräytyy AKT:n huoltokorjaamoalan työehtosopimuksen ja kokemuksesi mukaan. Erikoisosaamisesta olemme valmiita maksamaan erillistä ekstraa.Mikäli muutat työn perässä toiselta paikkakunnalta, voimme auttaa sinua asunnon hankinnassa. Odotamme sinulta alan koulutusta ja jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta raskaan kaluston parista, oikeaa asennetta ja vastuuntuntoa sekä tiimihenkeä. Suomen kielen C1 (Taitavan kielitaidon perustaso) vaaditaan työturvallisuuden vuoksi, sekä sujuvaan kommunikointiin muiden työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa. Mikäli tämä työ kiinnostaa sinua, laita hakemuksesi tulemaan samantien sillä käymme niitä läpi jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Toivomme sinulta:- Hyvää asennetta ja halua sitoutua mukavaan työpaikkaan ja työympäristöön- Joustavuutta työaikojen suhteen- Voimassa olevaa Työturvallisuuskorttia- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa- Ajokorttia c-kortti iso plussa hakijalle- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja ahkeruutta- Mielellään kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksista  Tarjoamme sinulle: - Luotettavan ja hyvän työnantajan- Kattavan perehdytyksen työhön- Laadukkaat työvarusteet- Mahdollisuuden työllistyä pitkäaikaiseen työhön- Työterveyshuollon Palkkausperuste: Tuntipalkka 16,47-19,85 €/hBenevanilla arvostamme: - Luotettavuutta - tehdään mitä sovitaan- Asennetta -teet aina parhaasi ja olet oma-aloitteinen- Työturvallisuutta - arvostamme työntekijöitä, joille työturvallisuus on tärkeää- Uskallus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin

Du bliver en del af en udviklingsorienteret og dynamisk virksomhed, hvor der er kort fra tanke til handling. Hverdagen byder på faglige udfordringer, gode kolleger og rig mulighed for at præge dine egne opgaver i en moderne økonomifunktion.

jobs.title: Analytiske konsulenter til styring af det specialiserede socialområde – udsatte børn og voksenområdet
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at styrke kommunernes styring af det specialiserede socialområde? Har du en stærk analyseprofil, og kan du omsætte data og komplekse problemstillinger til klare beslutningsgrundlag og handling? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i KL's Økonomiske Sekretariat. Det specialiserede socialområde er en af kommunernes største styringsudfordringer. Udgifterne udvikler sig, borgernes behov er komplekse, og kommunerne skal løbende træffe vanskelige prioriteringer på et område med stor betydning for både den enkelte borger og den samlede kommunale økonomi. Det stiller høje krav til sammenhængen mellem faglig indsats, økonomi, kapacitet og resultater. Vi søger en kollega, der vil arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i kontoret, fagkontorene i KL og i særdeleshed kommunerne om at udvikle styringen og skabe bedre grundlag for politiske og ledelsesmæssige beslutninger. Du skal kunne mestre store datamængder og analyser til at identificere mønstre, forklare drivkræfter og pege på konkrete handlemuligheder. Samt oversætte, hvad resultaterne betyder i praksis, så de kan føre til prioritering, forandring og handling. Det er derfor også en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til den kommunale praksis. Din hverdag KL's Økonomiske Sekretariat arbejder med kommunernes økonomiske, styringsmæssige og ledelsesmæssige dagsordener. I denne stilling får du et særligt fokus på det specialiserede socialområde og på at udvikle viden og løsninger, der kan styrke kommunernes styring på tværs af økonomi, faglighed og borgernes behov. Du får en central rolle i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger, KL's fagkontor og kommunerne. Du skal afdække styringsudfordringer, udvikle og udarbejde relevante analyser og skabe beslutningsgrundlag, som kan bruges af både administrative og politiske ledelser. Du skal kunne bevæge dig sikkert fra data og metode til fortolkning og anbefalinger - og være optaget af, hvordan ny viden bliver anvendt og gør en forskel i kommunernes praksis. Dine opgaver vil bl.a. være at:
  • Analysere udviklingen på det specialiserede socialområde med et stærkt greb om data, metode og komplekse problemstillinger og identificere de væsentligste økonomiske og styringsmæssige drivkræfter
  • Arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i kontoret og kommuner om at afdække udfordringer, behov og muligheder for en stærkere styring - med blik for samspillet mellem faglige hensyn, økonomi og kommunale beslutningsprocesser
  • Udvikle databaserede analyser, ledelsesinformation og beslutningsgrundlag, der understøtter kommunale prioriteringer
  • Omsætte faglig viden og analyseresultater til klare konklusioner, anbefalinger og konkrete handlemuligheder, der kan styrke kommunernes styring og prioritering
  • Facilitere faglige og strategiske drøftelser med kommuner og samarbejdspartnere, opbygge samarbejde og udfordre konstruktivt, så I skaber fælles retning og fremdrift
  • Formidle komplekse sammenhænge klart og målrettet, så de bliver forståelige, relevante og anvendelige for faglige, administrative og politiske målgrupper
  • Tage selvstændigt ansvar for at drive egne opgaver og processer fremad og bidrage med idéer til nye aktiviteter og løsninger
  • Indgå i en afvekslende hverdag med forskelligartede opgaver og tæt dialog med landets kommuner og andre relevante aktører - både i og uden for huset, fx ved kommunebesøg og konferencer
Vi søger en stærk analyseprofil, der kan omsætte viden til handling Vi forestiller os, at du har en relevant samfundsvidenskabelig uddannelse, fx cand.scient.pol., cand.polit., cand.scient.adm. eller tilsvarende, og gerne 2-3 års relevant erfaring fra en kommune, et konsulenthus, en interesseorganisation eller centraladministrationen. Du behøver ikke kende alle dele af det specialiserede socialområde på forhånd, men du skal have lyst til at forstå områdets dynamikker og bidrage til at udvikle styringen sammen med kommunerne. Et engageret kontor med høj faglighed og reel indflydelse Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor ambitionerne er høje, og hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med dagsordener, der har betydning for hele den kommunale sektor. Vi tilbyder et udfordrende og afvekslende job med stor mulighed for at præge egne opgaver og sætte retning i samarbejde med dygtige kolleger. Vores arbejdsform er præget af sparring, teamwork og et stærkt fælles engagement i de kommunale dagsordener. Tonen er uformel, samarbejdet tæt, og der er plads til både faglige diskussioner og godt kollegaskab i en hverdag med højt tempo. Vi tilbyder et spændende job i en af Danmarks største interesseorganisationer, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde tæt på både udvikling, beslutningsprocesser og kommunale prioriteringer - og hvor du samtidig kan udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt. Det praktiske Lyder stillingen som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning tirsdag d. 17. november 2026 Vi håber på at kunne byde vores nye kollega velkommen 1. januar 2027 eller snarest muligt herefter. Der afholdes løbende samtaler. Der kan blive gennemført test eller case mellem 1. og 2. samtale, ligesom der forud for ansættelse indhentes referencer. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling af tillæg på baggrund af dine kvalifikationer. Er du nysgerrig på at høre mere? Så kontakt kontorchef Jane Møller Pedersen (JMP@kl.dk, 3370 3836) for yderligere information. KL er interesse- og medlemsorganisation for de 98 kommunalbestyrelser i Danmark. KL bidrager til at udvikle og fastholde et stærkt lokalt demokrati. KL varetager kommunernes fælles interesser og er kommunernes samlede forhandlingsorganisation, videnscenter og forum for fælles initiativer og beslutninger. KL ser forskellighed i medarbejdersammensætningen og i ledelsen som en af vores styrker og opfordrer alle interesserede uanset personlig baggrund til at søge vores ledige stillinger. Kig forbi vores KL Karriereunivers og lær mere om os som arbejdsplads og medarbejdere. https://www.kl.dk/karriereunivers/forside

jobs.title: QEHS Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a proactive quality, environmental, health and safety professional who enjoys improving processes and working closely with production?**We are looking for a forward-thinking QEHS ENGINEER to join our team in Mäntyharju, Finland!**At Exel Composites, quality, health & safety, environmental responsibility and continuous improvement are integral parts of our daily operations. As our new QEHS Engineer, you will play an important role in developing these areas at our Mäntyharju manufacturing site. You will work closely with production and collaborate with application engineering, supply chain, and other functions. You will also interact with customers, suppliers, auditors and authorities as part of your responsibilities.This is a permanent position located at Exel Composites manufacturing site in Mäntyharju, Finland. The position reports to the Site Leader, Mäntyharju.**YOUR ROLE**You will coordinate and develop daily quality, environmental, occupational health and safety activities, ensuring compliance with customer, legal and certification requirements. The role also includes supervising the Mäntyharju laboratory team.Your key responsibilities include:- Maintain QEHS systems and documentation, and coordinate audits and follow-up with the QEHS Manager Finland. - Coordinate risk assessments, incident investigations, safety walks and follow-up actions. - Manage customer complaints, nonconformities and CAPA, including root-cause analysis, reporting and follow-up. - Support production, supplier and new-product quality, improve processes and reduce scrap through continuous improvement. - Monitor environmental compliance and support waste, chemical, emissions and environmental incident management. - Support occupational health, ergonomics and wellbeing with occupational health services. - Organise safety and quality training and inductions, monitor and report QEHS performance. - Act as the site's QEHS contact for customers and authorities within your remit, supporting visits and inspections. **WHAT YOU BRING**You take a practical, solution-focused and organised approach, turning analysis into improvements and involving others in change. You work comfortably in a manufacturing environment.You have:- B.Sc. degree in engineering, mechanical engineering, chemistry or another relevant field. - Experience working in an industrial environment. - Knowledge of quality and production-improvement methods and relevant legal and certification requirements. - Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems, together with auditing skills. - Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving and reporting skills. - Good communication skills, with the ability to drive practical improvements. - Good Finnish and English language skills, both written and spoken. **WHAT WE VALUE**The following are considered advantages:- Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, statistical tools, or quality-management and ERP systems. - QEHS experience in manufacturing, particularly chemicals or composites. - Experience with environmental permits, authorities, supplier quality, customer audits or new-product development. - Previous supervisory or team-leadership experience. **WHAT WE OFFER**We offer a varied, hands-on role where you can make a tangible impact on quality, safety and environmental performance at our Mäntyharju site. Working with advanced composite technologies in an international environment, you will collaborate across functions and locations to improve production processes and everyday practices. Your responsibilities will span operational improvement, management systems, audits and stakeholder cooperation, with scope to shape the role around your skills and experience.**INTERESTED?** We look forward to receiving your application and CV, including your salary expectations, by November 22, 2026.

Skapa ett **assistentkonto** och fyll i din profil noggrant. 3. Hitta jobbmöjligheter som passar dig. 4. Anmäl ditt intresse för ett jobb som passar dig. 5. Om du blir vald som kundens assistent kontaktar vi dig och ordnar tillsammans avtal, utdrag ur straffregistret, introduktion och allt annat praktiskt som behövs. **Det har aldrig varit så enkelt att få jobb. jobs.title: Kaupallinen ja tekninen päällikkö, Tammer Diesel
jobs.description: _Tammer Diesel on Tampereella vuonna 1954 perustettu perheyritys. Tunnistat kasvumahdollisuuksia, rakennat luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita ja osaat viedä myyntiprosessia tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin. Ymmärrät myös, miten tarjouslaskenta, hinnoittelu, tuotteistaminen ja toimivat prosessit vaikuttavat myynnin onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan kannattavuuteen.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- vahvaa teknistä osaamista ja kykyä hahmottaa teknisiä kokonaisuuksia - kokemusta B2B-myynnistä, suurasiakkuuksista tai teknisestä ratkaisumyynnistä. Kokemus B2C-myynnistä katsotaan eduksi. - kokemusta prosessien, palveluiden tai tuotteiden kehittämisestä ja kaupallistamisesta - osaamista nykyaikaisten markkinointikanavien hyödyntämisestä - hyviä johtamistaitoja ja kykyä saada tiimi onnistumaan yhteisten tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa - analyyttistä ja kehittävää työotetta sekä ymmärrystä liiketoiminnan tunnusluvuista - rohkeutta tarttua toimeen, tehdä päätöksiä ja viedä asioita eteenpäin myös silloin, kun valmista toimintamallia ei vielä ole - suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Miksi tämä tehtävä on kiinnostava?**Tammer Dieselillä saat vastuullisen työtehtävän johtoryhmän jäsenenä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten myydään, mitä asiakkaille tarjotaan ja miten tulevaisuuden kasvua rakennetaan. Saat keskeisen roolin strategisessa työssä ja toimit tiiviisti myös hallituksen kanssa. Työsuhde-etuihin kuuluu kattava vakuutus, liikunta– ja lounasetu sekä huollot ja varaosat henkilökuntahintaan. jobs.title: Expert Java CIAM Spring Security Migration Internationale - Freelance (H/F)

Maîtrise parfaite de Spring & Spring Security (Filters, Authentication Providers, etc.) 3. Maîtrise de l'Event-Driven (Kafka, CDC, pattern Outbox) 4. Expérience concrète d'outils de tracking (Amplitude) et de feature flagging / A/B testing (Statsig) 5. Compétences en Kubernetes, Helm, Datadog 6. Maîtrise des tests Playwright et Gatling/Blazemeter 7. Anglais technique (documentation impérative) 8. Atouts : notions de sécurité (OAuth 2.1 / OIDC), expérience sur Keycloak ou équivalent, sécurisation du code (OWASP), notions frontend (intégration SDK de tracking et flux CIAM)

jobs.title: Haemme uinninvalvojia

jobs.title: Souschef til køkken i Pincho Nation Horsens
jobs.description:
Er du klar til et job, hvor du kan vokse, bidrage til et fedt arbejdsmiljø og lede og motivere personale? Vi søger en Souschef til vores køkkenteam!

Om osVi er Pincho Nation, et sprudlende og anderledes restaurantkoncept med små tapasretter, ekstraordinære drinks og en oplevelse lidt ud over det sædvanlige. I vores kommende restaurant i Horsens lægger vi stor vægt på gæsteoplevelse, kvalitet, og teamwork. Hos os får du mulighed for at udvikle dig og være en vigtig del af vores team. Vi er passionerede omkring at skabe magiske oplevelser, og vi leder efter en, som deler denne passion.

Din rolleSom Souschef vil du arbejdet tæt sammen med Head Chef. Det er dit job at administrere og lede restaurantens køkkenproduktion når Head Chef ikke er der. Du er ansvarlig for at sikre at service forløber godt og effektivt, og at gæsteservice, hygiejne og produktivitet følger Pincho Nations standarder, såvel som resten af køkkenpersonalet. Som Souschef får du chancen for at udvikle både dit team, men også ansatte individuelt. En af vores kerneværdier er “people before business". Derfor bør det altid være en hovedprioritet for vores ledere at sikre en god produktkvalitet og samtidigt lede dit team på en omsorgsfuld og motiverende vis.

Hvem er du?Vi leder efter en, der:

  • Er motiveret for at arbejde i restaurationsbranchen og gerne vil være en del af vores koncept.

  • Ønsker at bidrage til et godt og positivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er ansvarlig, engageret og trives i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø.

  • Har erfaring fra lignende roller.

Hvad vi tilbyder:

  • Fællesskab og godt arbejdsmiljø: Vi sætter stor pris på et positivt arbejdsmiljø, og vi er altid klar på at hygge os sammen både på og udenfor arbejdet.

  • Løn: Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Medarbejderfordele: Personalerabat i alle vores restauranter, inkl. restauranter uden for Danmark, samt personaleevents.

Er du klar til at søge?Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Send din ansøgning og CV og fortæl os, hvorfor du har lyst til at være en del af vores team.

Ansøgninger behandles løbende, og vi afholder samtaler løbende. Stillingen besættes, så snart vi finder den rette kandidat, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Ansættelsesstart er 1. februar 2027.

--------------

Souschef – Pincho Nation Vejle

Are You Ready for a Job Where You Can Grow, Make a Difference, and Lead a Great Team?

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Souschef to join our kitchen team at Pincho Nation Horsens.

About Us

Pincho Nation is a vibrant and unique restaurant concept offering small tapas dishes, extraordinary cocktails, and an experience beyond the ordinary. In our coming restaurant in Horsens, we place great emphasis on guest experience, quality, and teamwork.

Joining us means becoming part of a dynamic team where you will have the opportunity to grow professionally and play an important role in our continued success. We are passionate about creating magical experiences for our guests, and we are looking for someone who shares that passion.

Your Role

As our Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef. Your primary responsibility will be to manage and lead the kitchen operation whenever the Head Chef is not present.

You will be responsible for ensuring that service runs smoothly and efficiently while maintaining Pincho Nation’s standards for food quality, guest satisfaction, hygiene, and productivity. You will also play an important role in supporting and developing the rest of the kitchen team.

One of our core values is "People Before Business." Therefore, we expect our leaders not only to deliver excellent results but also to lead their teams with care, respect, and motivation.

Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is motivated to work in the restaurant industry and excited to be part of our unique concept.

  • Wants to contribute to a positive and supportive working environment.

  • Is responsible, committed, and thrives in a fast-paced and dynamic workplace.

  • Has experience from a similar leadership role in a professional kitchen.

  • Enjoys coaching, developing, and motivating others.

What We Offer

Great Team Spirit and Work Environment

We highly value a positive workplace culture and enjoy spending time together both during and outside of work.

Salary will be based on qualifications and experience.

Employee Benefits

  • Staff discounts at all Pincho Nation restaurants, including locations outside Denmark.

  • Employee events and social activities.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional development within a growing restaurant concept.

Ready to Apply?

We would love to hear from you!

Send us your application and CV and tell us why you would like to become part of the Pincho Nation family.

We look forward to meeting you!

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be held continuously. We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible. The position will have first day at work February 1st, 2027.

jobs.title: Køkkenmedhjælper søges til børneinstitution på Østerbro – mulighed for længerevarende vikariat
jobs.description:
FIRMAVIKAR søger en erfaren og selvstændig køkkenmedhjælper til en børneinstitution på Østerbro i København med opstart mandag den 9. november 2026.

Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan tage det daglige ansvar for køkkenet og tilberede mad til ca. 60 børn.

Du kommer til at arbejde alene i køkkenet og skal derfor være tryg ved selvstændigt at planlægge og udføre dagens opgaver. Maden tilberedes ud fra en fastlagt menu/madplan, og du står for hele processen fra madlavning til oprydning og rengøring.

Vikariatet løber i første omgang fra 9. november til 18. december 2026, men der er rigtig gode muligheder for forlængelse i flere måneder eller længere.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning af daglige måltider til ca. 60 børn ud fra en fastlagt madplan.

  • Selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige drift af køkkenet.

  • Klargøring og forberedelse af råvarer og måltider.

  • Sikre god hygiejne og korrekt håndtering af fødevarer.

  • Opvask, oprydning og rengøring af køkkenet.

  • Øvrige praktiske køkkenopgaver efter behov.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med madlavning, gerne fra institutionskøkken, kantine eller storkøkken.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og er vant til at tage ansvar.

  • Kan tilberede mad til større grupper ud fra en menu eller madplan.

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

  • Har gode danskkundskaber.

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og grundig.

  • Kan starte mandag den 9. november 2026.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et vikariat i en børneinstitution på Østerbro.

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar for køkkenet.

  • Gode muligheder for forlængelse i flere måneder eller længere.

  • Et godt samarbejde og løbende kontakt med FIRMAVIKAR.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Østerbro, København ØOpstart: Mandag den 9. november 2026Varighed: Frem til 18. december 2026 i første omgang, med stor mulighed for forlængelseAnsættelsesform: Tidsbegrænset vikariat

Ansøgning

Har du erfaring med madlavning til større grupper, og kan du arbejde selvstændigt i et køkken? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV og gerne en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring til job@firmavikar.dk.

Skriv "Køkkenmedhjælper Østerbro" i emnefeltet.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker at finde den rette kandidat hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Cleaner / Housekeeper

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

You will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve the most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks from report to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Resolve customer issues leveraging your technical expertise and act as the primary point of escalation for our external support teams.

 - Reproduce customer issues, perform initial triage and file software defects and feedback with Engineering

 - Work cross-functionally across engineering and product to build processes and manage issues.

 - Develop deep product and platform expertise, diagnose and prevent recurring issues while contributing to feedback loops that improve both product quality and existing workflows.

 - Manage to key performance metrics defined within the CX Team.

 - Create and maintain internal knowledge libraries and contribute to the creation of user-facing content.

 - Should be open to 24/5 shift model and participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3-5 years in a support capacity focusing on escalated issue and/or technical troubleshooting. A track record of contributing to performance metrics like customer satisfaction and response time.

 - Exceptional problem-solving skills capable of diagnosing complex technical issues, querying data, and review product logs. You can drive problems to resolution efficiently and effectively.

 - Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners (i.e. Engineering, Product, and Operations) to drive long-term solutions and ensure customer feedback informs product improvements.

 - Proficiency in incorporating AI into day-to-day work (e.g., drafting and refining customer responses, summarizing context, analyzing trends, and accelerating troubleshooting) while applying strong judgment, privacy, and quality standards.

 - Experience contributing or owning projects to optimizing processes, workflows, and support operations that drive performance improvements. You have strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills**.** You are capable of distilling complex, technical material to non-technical audiences.

 - Ability to balance user expectations with policies and compliance boundaries. Ability to work under pressure while remaining focused and professional.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.

 - Experience with tools and technologies like Zendesk, SQL databases, APIs, AI tools.

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Keikkalaiseksi Riihitien palvelukotiin Liperiin (lähihoitaja, sosionomi, sairaanhoitaja)
jobs.description: Etsitkö joustavaa ja elämääsi sopivaa tapaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä? Me Honkalampi-säätiössä haemme nyt keikkalaisia **ohjaajan tehtäviin** Liperiin, Riihitien palvelukotiin. Taustaltasi voit olla esimerkiksi lääkeluvallinen**lähihoitaja, sosionomi tai sairaanhoitaja.**Riihitien palvelukoti tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista tukea tarvitseville aikuisille, joiden tuen tarpeen taustalla on esimerkiksi kehitysvamma. Meillä jokaisen arki rakentuu osallisuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja oikeudesta elää oman näköistä elämää. Huolehdimme turvallisesta ympäristöstä, jossa vuorovaikutus ja monipuoliset kommunikaation keinot ovat keskiössä. Haluamme, että kotimme on paikka, jossa jokainen tulee kuulluksi, ymmärretyksi ja kohdatuksi omana itsenään. Meillä koti on koti.**Millaista työ on?**Ohjaajana tuet ja mahdollistat asukkaidemme arkea heidän omien toiveidensa, tarpeidensa ja tavoitteidensa mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu hoitotyötä ja hyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä asukkaiden avustamista arjen askareissa, kuten kodinhoidossa, kaupassa käynnissä ja ulkoilussa.Lisäksi suunnittelet ja toteutat yhdessä asukkaiden kanssa heidän toiveistaan lähtevää yhteistä toimintaa, joka voi olla esimerkiksi liikkumista, leivontaa, pelaamista, retkiä, digitaitojen harjoittelua tai ihan vain yhdessä olemista ja jutustelua.Keikkalaisena toimit ohjaajan sijaisuuksissa tarpeen mukaan. Keikat voivat olla äkillisiä ja lyhyitä poissaolojen tuurauksia, mutta tarjoamme myös pidempiä sijaisuuksia ensisijaisesti keikkalaisillemme. Voit itse päättää, mitkä keikkapyynnöt hyväksyt.**Millaista työkaveria etsimme?**Etsimme kehitysvamma-alasta kiinnostuneita, ihmisläheisiä ja vastuullisia keikkalaisia. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä valmiutta ottaa vastaan sijaisuuksia myös lyhyellä varoitusajalla. Odotamme sinulta:- Soveltuvaa sote-alan koulutusta (esim. lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, sosionomi) tai vähintään 2/3 alan opinnoista suoritettuna - lääkehoidon koulutusta ja voimassa olevia lääketenttien suorituksia - voimassa olevaa sote-ammattikorttia - tartuntatautilain 48 § mukaista rokotesuojaa - hygieniapassia ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvitystä. Valitun työntekijän tulee esittää voimassa oleva rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkua.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- joustavan, elämääsi sopivan tavan tehdä töitä keikkalaisena - Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen tuntipalkan (kelpoisuusehdot täyttävän ohjaajan palkkaluokka G20C) - huolellisen perehdytyksen keikkalaisen tehtäviin - kokeneen ja helposti lähestyttävän esihenkilön ja työyhteisön tuen. Pääset osaksi ainutlaatuisten asukkaidemme arkea, saat arvokasta kokemusta kehitysvamma-alalta ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoiset työkaverit - meillä et jää yksin.**Näin haet meille töihin**Täytä hakemuslomake nettisivuillamme:https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/Lisätietoja tehtävistä voit kysyä osoitteesta rekrytointi@hl-s.fi .Voit tutustua asumispalveluiden arkeen Facebookissa: @Honkalampi Asumispalvelut tai Instagramissa: @honkalampiasumispalvelut ._Honkalampi on yhteiskuntavastuullinen yritys, jonka tavoitteena on pykälää parempi maailma. Käytämme taloudelliset voittovaramme asiakkaidemme palveluiden kehittämiseen ja yhteiskunnallisten haasteiden ratkaisemiseen. Tutustu meihin lisää osoitteessa www.honkalampi.fi .__Honkalammen asumispalvelut on savuton työpaikka._

Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.


Job Summary 

Aprio is seeking a Private Client Tax Manager, to lead a dedicated team of tax professionals delivering compliance, consulting, and planning services for individuals, trusts, and closely held businesses. In this role, you will develop and implement forward-thinking tax strategies, manage complex client relationships, and serve as a trusted advisor in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will drive business development, mentor and develop team members, and play a meaningful role in the continued growth of Aprio's private client practice.

 

 

\n


What You'll Gain/ Impact
  • Opportunity to lead and shape a high-performing team of tax professionals in a growing, high-impact practice
  • Exposure to sophisticated, multi-faceted engagements spanning individuals, trusts, and closely held businesses

  • A platform for business development and expanded client relationship ownership within a Top 20 CPA firm


Key Responsibilities
  • Review complex individual tax returns (Form 1040), trust returns (Form 1041), and business returns (Forms 1065, 1120S), ensuring accuracy and compliance with federal and state tax laws
  • Lead tax planning engagements for individuals and small business owners, advising on strategies including asset protection, succession planning, and retirement optimization
  • Manage multiple client relationships and engagements simultaneously, monitoring deadlines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure timely, high-quality service
  • Supervise and mentor staff preparing returns, providing technical guidance, quality review, and meaningful developmental feedback
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external advisors to deliver integrated, holistic client solutions
  • Identify and pursue business development opportunities, including expanding services with existing clients and participating in networking and prospecting activities

Candidate Qualifications

  • Preferred: CPA license or EA designation

Leadership Skills

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with financial planning concepts, including asset protection, succession planning, and retirement optimization strategies

jobs.title: Client Accounting Division Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Burkland's core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals as they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content because we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. Because of our demonstrated value, our clients have raised more than $17.8B!

At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees.

We are a remote-first company with over 185 team members, more than 800 clients, and a culture built on doing meaningful work with people who genuinely care about helping our clients grow. Come build something with us!


Role Summary

The Client Accounting Division Manager runs their division as a self-contained business unit within Burkland. The role owns the division's P&L and staffing, and is accountable not only for its own scorecard but for the aggregate performance of every KPI held by roles within the division. Success is measured by both business and people outcomes: revenue, margin, utilization, service quality, and client retention, alongside the growth and engagement of the people doing the work. The division supports consumer and product-based startups, so the manager brings deep inventory and cost accounting expertise to guide the teamâs technical work and client advice.

This is a hands-on people leadership role. The manager is expected to understand strengths and development needs of each team member in their business unit, set clear expectations, give consistent feedback, address performance issues early, and build a team that can deliver both accounting and proactive advisory work at a high standard. The manager also owns key client relationships and serves as the first-line escalation point for client issues, with a defined handoff path for anything beyond their resolution.

This job description outlines the core of the role, but it isn't meant to cover everything you'll do. As Burkland grows, your responsibilities may shift and new projects, tasks, or priorities may be added along the way. We hope you'll see that as a chance to stretch, learn, and broaden your contributions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Division Performance and KPI Accountability

  • Own the business unit's P&L, including revenue, margin, and utilization targets.

  • Drive aggregate performance across all KPIs assigned to Accounting Associates and Client Accounting Advisors, in addition to the manager's own scorecard.

  • Track division performance regularly, identify gaps early, and take corrective action at the individual and team level.

  • Report on division results to the Director of Accounting Advisory, including risks, trends, and planned actions.

  • Manage capacity and workload distribution across the division as well as assigning clients.

  • Contribute to pricing and fixed-fee scoping, and monitor engagement profitability.

  • Maintain awareness of AR and collections for division clients and address issues with the appropriate teams.

People Leadership and Staffing

  • Set clear role expectations and performance goals tied to the KPIs each team member owns.

  • Lead regular, structured 1:1s focused on goals, workload, development, and wellbeing, not only status updates. Use them to give direct, ongoing feedback that recognizes strong work and addresses gaps as they appear, rather than waiting for review cycles.

  • Create clear growth plans and provide ongoing coaching to develop each team member, in partnership with the Director and People Team

  • Conduct performance reviews, manage performance concerns directly, and contribute to compensation and promotion recommendations.

  • Monitor team capacity and engagement to support retention and prevent burnout.

  • Apply company policies consistently, manage time-off and leave requests, and bring performance concerns, employee relations matters, and escalations to the Director and People Team for guidance and resolution.

  • Plan staffing against current and forecasted client demand and build the business case for new headcount.

  • Lead hiring for the division through interviewing and selection, and onboard new team members so they reach full productivity within expected timelines.

Inventory Accounting and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee inventory valuation, reconciliation, and physical and cycle count processes across the divisionâs client portfolio, making sure variances are investigated and resolved quickly.

  • Set standards for costing methods (FIFO, LIFO, weighted average) and ensure the team applies them correctly by client and industry.

  • Ensure the team delivers accurate GAAP financial statements, inventory reporting, and COGS and gross margin analysis tailored to each clientâs business model.

  • Guide ERP and inventory software implementations, migrations, and improvements (partnering with ERP specialist where needed), and ensure client records stay audit-ready (as appropriate for the engagement size and scope).

  • Coach the team to help clients reduce shrinkage, obsolescence, overstocking, and stockouts, and to improve working capital through metrics like inventory turnover and days on hand.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations

Client Relationships and Service Quality

  • Act as an escalation point for client relationship issues.

  • Oversee quality control to ensure deliverables meet firm standards.

  • Shift the team's work from solely report delivery toward proactive advisory.

Growth and Operations

  • Own growth of the division's book of business through business development efforts to expand existing client relationships and identify service-expansion opportunities

  • Maintain accurate, current portfolio information in Knownwell

  • Drive full adoption of firm tools, systems, and processes, including AI-enabled workflows

Group and Company Success

A One Burkland mindset:

Our clients are best served when teams work together, not in silos. Partner closely with Tax, CFO, HR, and other service lines to create consistency, share knowledge, and deliver a seamless client experience across Burkland.

  • Comfort with an increasing pace of change:

Today's pace is the slowest we will experience going forward, not a finish line before things settle. As AI and related tools evolve, our processes evolve with them. This allows for more chances to learn, grow, and shape how the work gets done.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-driven efficiency:

Proactively look for smarter ways of working as new tools come online. This is about changing how the work gets done, not reducing the need for skilled people to do it.

  • A constructive attitude:

Attitude is contagious in both directions, across the team and with clients. Approach change with curiosity and enthusiasm. Help to set that tone for others rather than defaulting to resistance.

  • Full adoption of firm tools and processes:

Systems are critical to growth and often fail to be effective when only part of the team uses them well.

  • Delivery and proactive advisory:

Build real understanding of where each client's business is headed and advise ahead of it. Clients need the why behind their numbers, not just the numbers.

Core Competencies & Skills

  • Financial Acumen â cost management, margin analysis, fixed-fee scope adjustments, and AR/collections awareness.

  • Client Relationshipsâ Client relationship management, escalation handling, and spotting cross-sell and service-expansion opportunities.

  • Advisory mindset â Moving teams from report delivery alone to proactive advisory.

  • Leading Change â Champions of change, including AI-driven efficiency, leading by example in the consistent adoption of firm tools, systems and processes and reinforcing them across the team.

  • AI Fluency â Hands-on comfort using AI tools in accounting and operational work, with sound judgment about where AI adds value, where human review is required, and how to protect client data.

  • Cross-functional collaboration â Build strong working relationships across Service Delivery, partnering with other teams on shared client work and aligning with Growth on new client onboarding and cross-sell opportunities

  • Inventory and Cost Accounting Expertise â Deep knowledge of inventory accounting, costing methods, COGS, and GAAP, with the ability to guide a team through complex inventory work and system implementations. Strong understanding of supply chain methods such as contract manufacturing and 3PL operations as well as eCommerce operations and cash flows through Shopify, Amazon, eBay, and other marketplace solutions.

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business, accounting, finance, or a related field, and 5+ years of progressive professional experience

  • Direct people management experience, including conducting performance reviews, managing underperformance, and developing team members

  • Exceptional client relationship management skills and the ability to understand client needs

  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to prioritize, meet deadlines, and deliver high-quality results

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, team members, and leadership

  • Curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, and an eagerness to take on new challenges involving emerging technology and industries

  • Strong command of GAAP and cost accounting, including inventory accounting (FIFO, LIFO, landed costs, shrinkage, and valuation adjustments)

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA or CMA credential

  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to a team budget, P&L, or book of business

  • Prior experience leading a team within a professional services or client accounting environment

  • Hands-on ERP and inventory system experience (NetSuite, QuickBooks, Cin7, Fishbowl, or similar)

  • Experience leading or overseeing ERP or inventory software implementations

Â 

Physical & Environmental Demands

This is a remote position. Work is primarily performed at a computer for extended periods, requiring the ability to use a keyboard, view a screen, and communicate via video and phone. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

EEO Statement

Burkland Associates is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Burkland Associates is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or another legally protected status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please visit our careers page https://burklandassociates.com/careers/. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment-qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The base pay range target for the role described in this job description is 120,000-140,000. Final offer amounts depend on multiple factors such as candidate experience and expertise, geographic location, total compensation, and market data. In addition, full-time regular positions are eligible for, 401(k), health benefits, and other benefits; some of these benefits may be available for part-time.

Â

Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

 - Conduct compelling product demonstrations and help realize the art of the possible by orchestrating non-engineering hackathons

 - Articulate Replit's value proposition and align it with customers' business objectives

 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to ensure technical accuracy and successful delivery

 - Prepare tailored quotes and skillfully negotiate deals

 - Maintain accurate customer and forecasting data in Replit’s CRM (Hubspot)

 - Foster strong relationships with existing clients while identifying opportunities for expanded adoption

 - Optimize customers' use of the Replit platform through ongoing collaboration and support

 - Gather and communicate valuable customer feedback, championing their interests within Replit



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience in AE or SE/technical sales role, preferably in SaaS or developer tools

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet

 - Self-motivated with excellent time management and organizational skills

 - Passion for technology and staying current with industry trends

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

 - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for client meetings and events
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
   
   


TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM

 - ZoomInfo

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You’re not based in London area

 - You lack an understanding of the software development lifecycle; have little to no coding knowledge

 - You’re not passionate about AI

 - You don’t enjoy being in client facing roles where 80% of your day is talking to others





Note: This role will begin as remote, with plans to transition to a hybrid model once we establish a local office presence.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

 - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles

 - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit



To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.
