jobs.title: Fund Accountant (Medior) (24-months FTE contract)
jobs.description: FNZ is the global platform provider in the wealth management sector, partnering with over 650 of the world’s leading financial institutions and over 8,000 wealth management firms. With over 5,000 employees in 24 countries, FNZ’s mission is to open-up wealth, empowering all people to create wealth through personal investment, aligned with things they care about the most, on their own terms.The key responsibilities of the department include:Providing a high-quality Fund Accounting service to FNZ Ireland's clients and acting as a key point of contact for operational and accounting queries.Producing accurate and timely fund valuations and Net Asset Values (NAVs), ensuring all deadlines and regulatory requirements are met.Reviewing and analysing fund accounting information to identify and resolve discrepancies.Executing trades with international fund managers in accordance with client mandates and investment guidelines.Managing treasury activities and monitoring cash positions to ensure efficient liquidity management.Recording, reviewing and validating fund transactions in an accurate and timely manner.Performing complex reconciliations and investigating reconciling items to resolution.Assisting in the preparation of monthly, quarterly and annual financial and statutory reporting requirements.Liaising directly with clients, custodians, fund managers, brokers, auditors and banking partners on operational matters.Supporting new client onboarding, fund launches and change initiatives.Identifying opportunities to improve processes, controls and operational efficiency.Assisting in the training and development of junior team members and providing guidance on day-to-day activities.Utilising FNZ's technology platforms and reporting tools to investigate issues and enhance service delivery.Ensuring all activities are performed in line with internal controls, policies and regulatory requirements.The PersonThe ideal candidate will have previous experience in Fund Accounting, Investment Operations, Financial Services Operations or a related discipline. They will demonstrate strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to take ownership of deliverables within a fast-paced environment.They should also have:A degree in Commerce, Business Studies, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Mathematics or a related discipline.1-3 years' experience in Fund Accounting, Financial Services, Investment Operations or a similar role.A strong understanding of fund accountingFNZ combines technology, infrastructure and investment operations in a single state-of-the-art platform that frees its institutional customers to create hyper-personalized and innovative products and services, that are seamlessly aligned with the needs of their clients.

jobs.title: TRAKTORIST/TRAKTORISTICA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA:

  • prima radne zadatke i upute od Voditelja Sektora proizvodnje i Tehnologa mehanizacije
  • prije početka rada dužan je pregledati stroj ili opremu i o učenim nedostacima obavijestiti nadređenog, a nakon završetka rada stroj i ostala sredstva rada ostaviti uredne i o eventualnim nedostacima ili opasnostima obavijestiti nadređenog
  • obavlja prijevoz roba i proizvoda unutar i izvan Društva
  • radi na osnovnom obrađivanju zemljišta i pripremi zemljišta za sjetvu
  • radi na sjetvi
  • radi na zaštiti usjeva od bolesti, štetočina i korova
  • ubire proizvode (žetva, vršidba, vađenje, siliranje, kosidba i dr.)
  • održava strojeve
  • podešava priključne strojeve
  • radi sa žetvenim strojevima
  • vodi evidencije o izvršnom radu i utrošku goriva i maziva
  • obavlja sitne popravke na strojevima
  • rukovodi djelatnicima koji su dodijeljeni kao pratioci kod pojedinih poslova (sjetva, prskanje, žetva, raspodjeljivanje gnojiva i sl.)
  • pomaže kod obavljanja većih popravaka na traktoru (remont)
  • razni utovari i istovari
  • radi sa sredstvima za zaštitu bilja
  • radi na njezi kultura: kopanje, prorjeđivanje, zakidanje, zalamanje, navodnjavanje
  • radi na berbi i vađenju: pratilac kombajna, utovar, istovar, uskladištenje vreća, utovar i istovar i kamarenje slame – sijena po potrebi berba kukuruza, vađenje repe i krumpira

UVJETI:

  • KV- tehničkog usmjerenja
  • Jedna godina radnog iskustva na poslovima traktoriste
  • Vozačka dozvola B ili G kategorije
  • Stručno osposobljavanje za rukovatelja traktorom
  • Izobrazba o održivoj uporabi pesticida za korisnika

NUDIMO:

  • ugovor na određeno vrijeme uz mogućnost zasnivanja stalnog radnog odnosa,
  • mogućnost napredovanja i dodatnog usavršavanja,
  • timski rad, dinamično i stabilno poslovno okruženje

jobs.title: MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA
jobs.description:
MEHANIČAR/MEHANIČARKA- MEHATRONIČAR/MEHATRONIČARKA

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. Međusobna suradnja znači za nas međusobnu povezanost. Svi smo složni u uvjerenju da zajedno postižemo velike stvari.

Kao poduzeće. Kao tim. Kao obitelj.

Očekuju te sljedeći zadaci:

  • Redovito održavanje strojeva u proizvodnom pogonu
  • Utvrđivanje i otklanjanje kvarova na strojevima
  • Izvođenje servisa, remonta i montaže strojeva
  • Briga o zalihi rezervnih dijelova
  • Godišnje provođenje ispitivanja elektro uređaja

Što donosiš sa sobom:

  • Završena škola: elektrotehničar, elektromehaničar, mehatroničar ili električar, stručnjak za pneumatiku i hidrauliku
  • Poželjno radno iskustvo minimalno 2 godine u području održavanja pneumatskih i hidrauličnih strojeva
  • Pouzdanost i samostalnost u obavljanju radnih zadataka
  • Izraženi timski duh
  • Fleksibilnost
  • Poželjno poznavanje engleskog ili njemačkog jezika u govoru i pismu

Što te očekuje:

  • Rad u internacionalnom okruženju
  • Stimulativna primanja
  • Mogućnost napredovanja
  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme
  • Poticajna i prijateljska radna atmosfera
  • Uvođenje u posao pod vodstvom mentora
  • Dvosmjenski rad
  • Vrhunska oprema i postrojenje
  • Veliki benefit paket (npr. team building, božićni domjenak, sportske aktivnosti, osiguranje 0-24, uplata u 3. mirovinski stup i još mnoge pogodnosti)

  • završen sveučilišni diplomski studij

  • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i

Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici. Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka.   • 1 collaboratore/collaboratrice professionale – pedagogista in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo determinato (supplenza) con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici
CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformita' all'articolo 29, comma 1 a) del Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20):
  • laurea
  • padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana
2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 2 novembre 2026.

jobs.title: PRODAJNI/A SAVJETNIK/CA – PRODAJA SOLARNIH ELEKTRANA
jobs.description: TERENSKI/A PRODAJNI/A PREDSTAVNIK/CA ZA SOLARNE ELEKTRANE Green Bean traži prodajnu osobu za aktivno pronalaženje kupaca solarnih elektrana, prvenstveno vlasnika obiteljskih kuća. Kako izgleda posao? Glavninu rada čine terenski obilasci sela i manjih mjesta u okolici Zagreba. Obilazite dodijeljeno područje, neposredno pristupate vlasnicima kuća i započinjete razgovore o mogućnosti ugradnje solarne elektrane. Važan dio posla čine kontakti bez prethodno dogovorenog sastanka. Očekujemo da samostalno stvarate nove prodajne prilike te zainteresirane kupce pratite od prvog razgovora do ugovaranja. Glavni poslovi: • planiranje i obilazak dodijeljenog područja • osobno kontaktiranje vlasnika kuća i predstavljanje ponude • prepoznavanje interesa i prikupljanje podataka potrebnih za izradu ponude • dogovaranje daljnjih sastanaka i tehničkih obilazaka • prezentacija ponuda te redoviti telefonski, e-mail i osobni kontakt s kupcima do njihove odluke • vođenje evidencije kontakata i prodajnih aktivnosti • suradnja s tehničkim i operativnim timom Koga tražimo? Osobu kojoj odgovara svakodnevni teren, koja može samostalno započeti razgovor s nepoznatom osobom i ustrajno pratiti prodajne prilike. Važno nam je kako pristupate kupcu, slušate njegove potrebe i postupate nakon odbijanja. Prednost imaju kandidati s dokazivim iskustvom u samostalnom pronalaženju i pridobivanju novih kupaca, osobito kroz neposrednu terensku prodaju. Iskustvo sa solarnim elektranama ili tehničkim proizvodima predstavlja prednost, ali nije uvjet. Osiguravamo edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i našem prodajnom procesu. Obavezni su vozačka dozvola B kategorije i spremnost na svakodnevnu vožnju i terenski rad. Što nudimo? • fiksnu mjesečnu plaću od najmanje 1.100 EUR neto • bonus vezan uz ostvarene prodajne rezultate • službeno vozilo za obavljanje posla tijekom radnog vremena • edukaciju o solarnim elektranama i prodajnom procesu • suradnju s tehničkim i operativnim timom Prijava: Pošaljite životopis na info@greenbean.hr i kratko, vlastitim riječima, odgovorite na dva pitanja: 1. Opišite jednu prodaju kupcu kojeg ste sami pronašli. Kako ste došli do njega, što ste osobno poduzeli i kako je završilo? Ako nemate takvo iskustvo, navedite to. 2. Zamislite da tijekom obilaska sela prilazite vlasniku kuće koji Vas ne očekuje. Kako biste započeli razgovor i što biste rekli ako odgovori: „Ne zanima me“

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect (f/m/d)  IT/OT Security Platforms (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description: Together, we make the differenceSiemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.As a Solution Architect (f/m/d) for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts.As part of our team, you will have- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interestsSince each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.What part will you play?- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements. - You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases. - You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints. - You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps. - You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens. - You define integration concepts between connectivity services, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems. - You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape. - You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability. - You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.What you bring to the table- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification. - Experience & Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443. - You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures. - You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps. - You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design. - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- Ways of working:- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments. - You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usWe know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority.Our global,diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Productization Specialist / Product Lifecycle Engineer to join a New Product Introduction (NPI) team responsible for bringing new products successfully from development into production.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

In this role, you will act as a key link between R&D, production, sales, and business operations, ensuring that new products, features, and solutions are implemented efficiently and according to agreed processes. You will play an important role in developing productization practices, supporting projects, and helping the organization scale new products into successful business.

Key Responsibilities:
 Coordinate the implementation of new products into production
 Develop and maintain productization concepts and best practices
 Support R&D, production, and sales throughout different project phases
 Ensure adherence to agreed business processes and transfer-to-business procedures
 Gather and specify requirements for new functionalities and process improvements
 Participate in testing and validation activities

What Were Looking For:
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Engineering or a related field
 Minimum 2 years of experience in productization, NPI, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role
 Understanding of electronics and software product development environments

 Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills

- Are you familiar with electronics and/or software product development environments?*
- Do you have experience using Azure DevOps or similar lifecycle management tools?*
- Have you participated in testing, validation, or implementation activities for new products or processes?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy

India Spice is a passionate Indian restaurant and catering kitchen with a deep love for rich flavors, authentic spices, and traditional culinary craftsmanship.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Outcome Architects (Customer Success)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are looking for a proven Outcomes Architects Manager with a strategic and entrepreneurial spirit to join the GTM Team. As the Commercial OA Leader, you will play an important role defining/iterating on our expand motions, providing customer feedback to help share our roadmap, driving increased adoption, owning ongoing value delivery, and and generating expansion revenue to grow our business. You will own the strategy and execution of your team’s segment.

The Outcomes Architect team is a new function at Notion that combines RM, CSM and SE capabilities to drive workflow adoption and retention at our customers.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Increase Team Performance on Adoption, Retention, and Customer Value: Your role centers on up-leveling the team to boost product adoption, retention, customer value, and satisfaction through effective retention strategies and churn prevention in the Commercial segment (note that your team will own a subset of renewals).

jobs.title: LEDIG STILLING- ØKONOMIANSVARLIG – BEBOERØKONOMI
jobs.description:
Vil du bidra til en trygg og forsvarlig økonomisk oppfølging av beboerne våre?

Voss ordinære asylmottak søker en strukturert, nøyaktig og ansvarsbevisst økonomiansvarlig med hovedansvar for beboerøkonomi og refusjonskrav til Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI).

Hva vi ser etter

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ønsker at du har:

  • Utdanning innen økonomi, regnskap eller administrasjon. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

  • God tallforståelse og gode ferdigheter i Excel.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter.

  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert og håndtere flere oppgaver samtidig.

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Evne til å håndtere konfidensiell informasjon på en trygg og profesjonell måte.

Erfaring med økonomiadministrasjon, refusjonskrav, dokumentasjonsarbeid eller arbeid ved asylmottak vil være en fordel. Kjennskap til UDIs regelverk og rutiner for økonomiske ytelser og refusjoner er ønskelig.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Møter alle beboere med respekt, verdighet og forståelse, uavhengig av bakgrunn og livssituasjon.

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og behersket, også i utfordrende situasjoner.

  • Håndterer stress og arbeider effektivt under press.

  • Er nøyaktig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Har høy integritet og behandler fortrolige opplysninger med diskresjon.

  • Arbeider selvstendig og tar initiativ innenfor eget ansvarsområde.

  • Er løsningsorientert og håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en profesjonell måte.

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer tydelig og respektfullt med både beboere og kolleger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

1. Beboerøkonomi

  • Administrere og følge opp beboernes økonomiske ytelser.

  • Beregne og kontrollere utbetalinger i henhold til gjeldende satser og retningslinjer.

  • Sørge for korrekt og rettidig utbetaling av økonomiske ytelser.

  • Registrere og dokumentere alle utbetalinger.

  • Kontrollere utbetalingslister, kvitteringer og økonomiske bilag.

  • Følge opp endringer i beboernes situasjon som påvirker økonomiske ytelser.

  • Utarbeide oversikter og rapporter knyttet til beboerøkonomi.

2. Refusjonskrav til UDI

  • Utarbeide, kontrollere og sende refusjonskrav til UDI i henhold til gjeldende rutiner og frister.

  • Kontrollere at utgifter som kreves refundert, er dokumentert og oppfyller gjeldende vilkår.

  • Sikre at nødvendig dokumentasjon, bilag og kvitteringer vedlegges refusjonskravene.

  • Følge opp innsendte refusjonskrav og eventuelle spørsmål eller tilbakemeldinger fra UDI.

  • Registrere og følge opp godkjente, avslåtte og utestående refusjonskrav.

  • Bidra til god intern økonomikontroll og korrekt rapportering av refusjonsberettigede utgifter.

3. Generelle administrative oppgaver

  • Sikre forsvarlig arkivering og behandling av økonomiske opplysninger.

  • Følge opp økonomiske avvik og bidra til gode interne kontrollrutiner.

  • Samarbeide tett med mottaksleder og øvrige ansatte.

  • Gi beboerne nødvendig informasjon om økonomiske ytelser og utbetalingsrutiner.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull stilling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver med et tydelig ansvarsområde.

  • Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheten til å bidra til god økonomisk forvaltning og forsvarlig drift av mottaket.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lilandtunet AS

Lilandtunet AS er et norsk selskap med base i Voss, Vestland. Selskapet har bakgrunn fra hotell- og gjestfrihetsbransjen, men har tilpasset sin virksomhet til å tilby innkvartering for asylsøkere.

I dag driver Lilandtunet AS Voss ordinære asylmottak på oppdrag fra Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI), gjennom en inngått driftsavtale. Selskapet er opptatt av å tilby trygge, verdige og forsvarlige boforhold, og å skape et inkluderende og godt miljø for beboerne, samtidig som virksomheten drives på en profesjonell og ansvarlig måte.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.

jobs.title: Barchef søges til Sukiaba på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky
jobs.description:
Barchef – SUKAIBA

Vil du stå i spidsen for en af Københavns mest spektakulære cocktailbarer?

På toppen af Bella Sky finder du Restaurant Sukaiba – en Restaurant og Cocktail bar som er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor gastronomi, udsigt og atmosfære smelter sammen i en helstøbt gæsteoplevelse.

Her forenes asiatisk inspireret gastronomi med ambitiøse vin- og cocktailparringer og en professionel servicekultur, hvor kvalitet, kreativitet og værtskab går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger nu en passioneret og visionær Barchef, der vil tage ejerskab over vores cocktailbar og være med til at udvikle den til noget helt særligt. En fagligt stærk profil, der brænder for cocktails, værtskab og ledelse, og som kan skabe retning, engagement og høj kvalitet i baren.

ROLLEN

Som Barchef får du det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift, udvikling og personale. Du bliver den faglige drivkraft bag baren og får en central rolle i at sætte standarden for både kvalitet, kreativitet og gæsteoplevelser.

Du arbejder i tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og indgår som en vigtig del af restaurantens samlede ledelsesteam. Med reference til Restaurantchefen har du selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren og dens medarbejdere.

Dine ansvarsområder omfatter:

  • Det overordnede ansvar for cocktailbarens daglige drift og performance

  • Ledelse, udvikling og motivation af barens bartendere

  • Rekruttering, onboarding og oplæring af nye medarbejdere i samarbejde med Restaurantchefen

  • Udvikling og løbende fornyelse af cocktailkortet med fokus på kreativitet, kvalitet og sæsonens råvarer

  • Sikring af høje faglige standarder inden for cocktails, præsentation og værtskab

  • Ansvar for barens indkøb, lagerstyring, vareforbrug og omkostningsoptimering

  • Udvikling af nye cocktailkoncepter og kreative drinksoplevelser

  • Sikring af struktur, arbejdsrutiner og effektive arbejdsgange bag baren

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkkenet og Restaurantchefen om vin- og cocktailparringer samt restaurantens samlede gæsteoplevelse

  • Aktiv deltagelse i driften, hvor du går forrest og viser vejen for dit team

Du er både en kreativ cocktailprofil og en stærk leder. Du formår at kombinere passionen for håndværket med struktur, økonomisk forståelse og evnen til at udvikle mennesker.

VI SØGER DIG, DER

  • Har minimum 3 års erfaring fra cocktail- eller restaurantbranchen

  • Har solid erfaring med cocktailhåndværk og en naturlig interesse for nye teknikker, smage og trends

  • Gerne har erfaring fra en lignende rolle som Barchef, Assistant Bar Manager eller Lead Bartender

  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse eller et naturligt talent for at motivere og udvikle andre

  • Har forståelse for økonomi, vareforbrug, lagerstyring og indkøb

  • Brænder for værtskab og for at skabe ekstraordinære gæsteoplevelser

  • Arbejder struktureret og tager naturligt ansvar for både kvalitet og drift

  • Er kreativ, initiativrig og ikke bange for at udfordre det eksisterende

  • Er en holdspiller med positiv energi og en professionel tilgang til samarbejde

Du har ambitioner på barens vegne og motiveres af at skabe noget, der skiller sig ud. Du går op i detaljen, men forstår samtidig betydningen af det store billede.

VI TILBYDER

  • En central lederstilling med selvstændigt ansvar for cocktailbaren

  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på barens identitet, cocktailkort og udvikling

  • Stor kreativ frihed til at eksperimentere og udvikle nye cocktailoplevelser

  • Mulighed for at udvikle og forme dit eget barteam

  • Et tæt samarbejde med Restaurantchefen og resten af restaurantens ledelsesteam

  • En dynamisk og ambitiøs arbejdsplads med højt til loftet

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med stærke værdier og udviklingsmuligheder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke

HVORFOR VÆLGE SUKAIBA?

Hos Sukaiba er ambitionerne høje, men fællesskabet er mindst lige så vigtigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes gennem engagement, gensidig respekt og en fælles passion for det, vi laver.

Vi ønsker at skabe en cocktailbar, hvor kreativitet, kvalitet og personlighed går hånd i hånd – og hvor både gæster og medarbejdere har lyst til at komme igen.

Vi er en del af Norrlyst Koncernen, hvor der er gode muligheder for sparring, udvikling og karriere på tværs af organisationen.

PRAKTISK

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Vuokrasihteeri, Leppävirran Vuokrakodit
jobs.description: Haemme vuokrasihteeriä vakituiseen, kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työyhteisöstämme on avautumassa paikka pitkäaikaisen vuokrasihteerin eläköitymisen takia. Tarjoamme hyvän perehdytyksen työhön ja mukavan työyhteisön, jossa on joustava ja rento ilmapiiri.Työhön kuuluu Leppävirran Vuokrakotien (Leppävirran Kiinteistö Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Leppävirran Majurinpelto) ja Leppävirran Kunnan asuinhuoneistojen ja liiketilojen vuokraus.Työ on pääsääntöisesti itsenäistä asiakaspalvelutyötä, jossa kohtaat työssäsi päivittäin kaikki asunnon vuokrauksen vaiheet. Vuokrasihteerin päivittäiseen työhön kuuluu käsitellä asuntohakemuksia, tehdä asukasvalintoja, tarjota asuntoja, tehdä vuokrasopimuksia ja käsitellä irtisanomisilmoituksia, sekä tehdä asukaslaskutusta. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - NLP
Lead Game Programmer
jobs.description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

jobs.title: Nordic Certification Coordinator
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at koordinere certificeringsaktiviteter på tværs af Norden og sikre en professionel og effektiv service til vores kunder?

Control Union Denmark A/S søger en struktureret og serviceminded Nordic Certification Coordinator, som får en central rolle i koordineringen af vores certificeringsaktiviteter. Du bliver en del af en international virksomhed og får en alsidig hverdag med kontakt til kunder, auditorer og kolleger i både Danmark og de øvrige nordiske lande.Som Nordic Certification Coordinator bliver du et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, auditorer og vores interne organisation. Du får ansvar for at koordinere certificeringsforløb og sikre, at opgaver, dokumentation og deadlines bliver håndteret korrekt og effektivt.Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Koordinering og planlægning af audits og certificeringsaktiviteter

  • Daglig kontakt med kunder, auditorer og kolleger i Norden

  • Opfølgning på igangværende certificeringsforløb og deadlines

  • Behandling, kontrol og arkivering af dokumentation

  • Vedligeholdelse af kunde- og certificeringsoplysninger i relevante systemer

  • Udarbejdelse og udsendelse af tilbud, aftaler og certifikater

  • Koordinering med internationale kolleger og øvrige Control Union-kontorer

  • Besvarelse af kundehenvendelser og administrativ support

  • Deltagelse i kundebesøg, messer, træning og relevante arrangementer

  • Bidrag til løbende forbedring af interne arbejdsgange og processer

Opgaverne kan udvikle sig i takt med virksomhedens aktiviteter og dine kompetencer.Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, administration, kundeservice eller certificering

  • Arbejder struktureret og har et godt overblik

  • Er detaljeorienteret og følger opgaver helt til dørs

  • Kommunikerer professionelt og imødekommende med både kunder og kolleger

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå aktivt i et internationalt team

  • Har gode IT-kundskaber og let ved at sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • Behersker engelsk på et godt professionelt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt

  • Har mulighed for at deltage i kundebesøg, messer, audits og andre aktiviteter, hvor der kan forekomme rejseaktivitet

Erfaring fra certificerings-, audit-, kvalitets- eller fødevareområdet er et krav.Vi tilbyder:

  • En alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade i en international organisation

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra vores kontor i Randers samt fra hjemmekontor efter aftale

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdsdagen

  • Pensionsordning med sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Et samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar

Der kan i perioder forekomme arbejde uden for almindelig arbejdstid i forbindelse med blandt andet rejser, messer, træning og uddannelse.Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til rm@controlunion.dk senest 30.11.2026.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og forbeholder os retten til at afslutte rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Tiltrædelse: Efter aftaleArbejdssted: Randers,og mulighed for hjemmearbejdeAnsættelsesform: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen

jobs.title: Technical Writer, Fixed term
jobs.description: **Contract type:** Fixed-term**Location & Travel:** Helsinki (Remote first, Occasional travel to the Helsinki area is required.)**Career Opportunity:** This fixed-term position may lead to a permanent offer in customer support, quality assurance, or project deliveries based on performance, aspirations, and business needs.AILiveSim provides an advanced simulation platform that integrates AI, robotics, and video game technology. Located in Helsinki, we serve a variety of industries, including maritime, defence, aeronautics, and mobile machines. With controlled simulations, we accelerate the development cycles and provide scalable solutions for training, testing, and validating autonomous systems and AI algorithms.To support our growing user base and ensure our platform is as accessible as possible, we are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer. In this role, you will be responsible for translating complex technical concepts into clear and easy-to-understand documentation. This is an opportunity to work closely with cutting-edge AI, robotics, and simulation technology while shaping how our clients and developers interact with our platform.**Key Responsibilities**- **Documentation Creation:** Write, edit, and maintain high-quality product, technical documentation, including user manuals, tutorials, and both customer- and AI-facing documentation resources. - **Knowledge Delivery Processes:** Define and develop various ways to convey information, documentation, example scripts, tutorials and configuration files manually or with AI code assistants. - **Content Organization:** Structure and organize technical content to ensure it is highly searchable, intuitive, and user-friendly for both internal teams and external clients. - **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with software engineers, product specialists, and the sales team to deeply understand new platform features, updates, and user needs. - **Standardization & Review:** Establish documentation standards and review existing technical materials for clarity, accuracy, and consistency across all company channels. - **User-Centric & Adaptive Approach:** Gather feedback from users and internal teams to continuously improve the usability and comprehensiveness of our documentation, evolving content based on user profiles and technical requirements. **Requirements**- **Technical Writing Experience:** Track record in writing software or technical documentation. - **Communication Skills:** Excellent written and spoken English skills, with a talent for breaking down complex, highly technical concepts into simple, readable language. - **Technical Abilities:** Comfort and enthusiasm for learning complex software systems, with the ability to quickly grasp concepts related to 3D simulation tools, robotics, and AI. **Valuable Assets**- Experience reading or working with programming languages (such as C++ or Python) and documenting APIs. - Interest or background in AI, robotics, 3D graphics, game technologies (e.g., Unreal Engine), or autonomous systems. - Experience creating visual aids, diagrams to supplement written documentation. - Experience creating AI readable documentation, such as instruction files, schemas, Model Context Protocols **How to Apply** To apply, please send your CV, cover letter, and a link to your portfolio or writing samples with "Technical Writer" in the subject line to Jobs@ailivesim.com.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position will be filled as soon as a qualified candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Assistant Archivist
jobs.description: Role ProfileThe successful candidate will report to the Librarian & Archivist, to process and catalogue incoming collections of archives and promote the content of the Library’s extensive holdings. The candidate will be part of the Library team and contribute to its ongoing work and outreach.BackgroundThe Library of the Representative Church Body provides a repository for the Church of Ireland’s archives, manuscripts and related objects which tell the story of the Church’s community. These include records from parishes throughout Ireland, the archives of the Church’s dioceses, cathedrals, architectural drawings, the administrative records of the Representative Church Body and its multiple committees, and thousands of manuscripts relating to the Church’s people, buildings and activities, spanning from medieval times to the present. Some have relevance for a worldwide research audience, and public engagement with that audience is an important Library function.Specific Responsibilities•    Assisting in the processing and cataloguing of incoming collections;•    Updating and uploading finding aids to the Library’s web pages;•    Contributing to the Library’s ongoing digitization projects including managing projects on a book scanner and digital slide scanner;•    Assisting visitors and answering public enquires;•    Initiating and managing exhibition projects and contributing to raising the profile of the Library and its varied collections;•    Oher projects and tasks as may be assigned by the Librarian and Archivist.Person SpecificationEducation / Training    Essential•    A primary degree in history or other relevant discipline•    A recognised postgraduate qualification in archive or library studies Desirable•    Professional member of the ARA (Archives and Records Management Association)Experience    Essential•    A minimum of three years’ experience working in an archive, including at least one year’s experience in a religious archive.•    Experience digitising archival materials across multiple formats (including paper records, photographic material, and slides)•    Proven experience of completing archival projects in a systematic and timely fashion•    Experience of collaboration, teamwork and building relationshipsDesirable•    Knowledge of latest digitisation systems (eg. Book2Net Lizard, Tocosa, Silverfast9). Knowledge / Skills    Essential•    Excellent communication skills including making presentations and engaging with relevant stakeholders•    Experience curating small displays for exhibition•    Proficient in Microsoft Access (including database management and reporting)•    Experience in developing and managing websites and organisational social media accounts, including updating content and maintaining an online presence.•    Excellent organisational and inter-personal skills with proven ability to work to deadlines and prioritise workloadsDesirable•    Experience researching and writing content for publications including online and print content

jobs.title: Videnskabelig assistent til kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse i uddannelsesvidenskab
jobs.description:
Ved Det humanistiske Fakultet, Syddansk Universitet i Odense er en fuldtidsstilling som videnskabelig assistent inden for uddannelsesvidenskab med særligt fokus på kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analyse ledig til besættelse 1. januar 2027 og ét år frem.

Den videnskabelige assistent vil skulle arbejde på forskellige større og mindre forskningsprojekter, alle ledet af professor Ane Qvortrup. Fælles for projekterne er, at de undersøger danske og europæiske gymnasie- og erhvervsuddannelseselevers trivsel, selvforståelser og undervisningsoplevelser. Yderligere projekter kan komme til. 

De primære arbejdsopgaver vil bestå i kvantitativ dataindsamling og statistisk analysearbejde samt deltagelse i øvrige forskningsopgaver i relation til projekterne. Der søges en medarbejder, der har stærke kompetencer inden for kvantitative metoder, herunder i særdeleshed surveymetodik, og som har erfaring med uddannelsesvidenskabelig forskning. Ligeledes forventes gode kompetencer inden for mundtlig og skriftlig kommunikation.

jobs.title: Night Receptionist for winter season 2026-2027
jobs.description: Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad. We are looking for skilled, experienced, and service-oriented night receptionist for the winter season 2026-2027. A Night Receptionist is responsible for assisting our guests and making sure they feel safe and well taken care of during the night. The work mainly involves helping guests with different requests, both by phone, messages and in person around the resort.Guest requests can be anything from bringing an extra blanket or helping with sauna instructions to opening a door if a guest has locked themselves out. You need to be ready to handle different situations and find solutions independently. The work requires a responsible, flexible and solution-oriented attitude, as you will be working independently during night shifts.The contract is seasonal, starting as soon as possible and ending at the end of March 2027. We provide full-time hours. The work schedule consists of 5 night shifts followed by 2 days off.The role will involve: * Assisting guests with their requests by phone, messages and in person * Helping guests with practical issues around the resort * Handling unexpected situations and finding solutions * Making sure guests feel safe and well taken care of during the night * Supporting other resort operations when neededDesired qualifications, skills, and experience: * Fluent in written and spoken English. Other languages are an advantage. * Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience * Previous experience in hotel reception work and night shifts is required * A valid driving license is required * Good experience and confidence in winter driving * Ability to work independently and make decisions * A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented attitude * Excellent customer service skillsWe have two receptions serving our guests during the winter season, in East Village and West Village. The Night Receptionist will work at our West Village reception, and the night receptionist takes care of our guests staying in both villages.The location of the resort is in the middle of beautiful nature. Here you also have time to enjoy nature and try different activities that you might not get to experience otherwise. We have a small gym for our staff, as well as opportunities to try cross-country skiing and other winter activities.You need to have a valid right to work in Finland, either through an EU/EEA citizenship or a valid residence permit that allows working in Finland. It is possible to rent an apartment through us, so joining our team is easy wherever you are coming from.In terms of employment, we follow the collective agreement of the tourism and restaurant industry (MaRa TES). The salary is based on the collective agreement and depends on your previous work experience and education.We review applications already during the application period, so we may contact suitable candidates before the application deadline.You can also read [https://kakslauttanen.teamtailor.com/posts]our blog to see how it's like to work at Kakslauttanen.

jobs.title: Kehityspäällikkö, mobiiliteknologiat | Erillisverkot / Espoo, Jyväskylä, Tampere, Kuopio, Turku, Oulu
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana kehittämässä yhteiskunnan kannalta kriittisiä viestintäratkaisuja ja tulevaisuuden mobiiliverkkoteknologioita?Haemme Ervejoukkoomme KEHITYSPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ mobiiliteknologioiden kehitykseen.Erillisverkot on valtion omistama yhtiö, jolla on erityinen tehtävä: me tarjoamme viranomaisille ja huoltovarmuustoimijoille turvalliset ja toimintavarmat ict-palvelut kaikissa olosuhteissa. Ne takaavat sen, että Suomi on maailman turvallisin maa nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Erillisverkkolaiset ovat yhteiskunnan turvaajia, joihin voi luottaa tiukoissakin paikoissa.**Tässä tehtävässä** pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten uusia mobiiliteknologioita ja -ratkaisuja hyödynnetään turvallisuusviranomaisten ja muiden kriittisten toimijoiden välisessä kommunikaatiossa. Roolissa yhdistyvät teknologiaosaaminen, tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiotoiminta, hankkeet sekä uusien ratkaisujen vieminen käytännön palveluiksi ja liiketoiminnaksi.Kehityspäällikkönä vastaat mobiiliteknologioiden kehittämisestä ja osallistut niiden hankintaan sekä uusien ratkaisujen arviointiin. Toimit asiantuntijana Erillisverkkojen tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiotoiminnassa sekä kansallisissa ja kansainvälisissä kehityshankkeissa. Tärkeä osa tehtävääsi on tunnistaa uusia teknologisia mahdollisuuksia ja viedä niitä kokeiluista ja innovaatioista kohti tuotannollisia ratkaisuja ja liiketoimintaa.**Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa**- mobiiliteknologioihin perustuvien palveluiden ja liiketoiminnan kehittäminen - mobiiliteknologioiden ja -ratkaisujen kehittäminen - 5G- ja 6G-teknologioiden sekä radioverkkoarkkitehtuurien kehityksen seuraaminen ja arviointi - osallistuminen teknologioiden ja ratkaisujen hankintaan - asiantuntijatehtävät tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiohankkeissa - kansallisiin ja kansainvälisiin hankkeisiin sekä asiantuntijaverkostoihin osallistuminen - uusien teknologioiden pilotointi ja soveltuvuuden arviointi - ratkaisujen vieminen innovaatiovaiheesta kohti palveluita ja liiketoimintaa - yhteistyö teknologiatoimittajien, kumppaneiden, asiakkaiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Toimipisteesi voi sijaita valintasi mukaan Espoossa, Jyväskylässä, Tampereella, Kuopiossa, Turussa, Oulussa tai muussa Erillisverkkojen toimipisteessä. Hyödynnämme joustavaa hybridityömallia, jossa osa työstä on mahdollista tehdä etänä. Työ sisältää matkustamista kotimaassa ja ulkomailla.**Odotamme sinulta**- hyvää mobiiliteknologioiden ja -standardien tuntemusta - osaamista 5G- ja 6G-teknologioista, erityisesti radioverkkojen näkökulmasta - liiketoiminnan kehitysosaamista - tuotekehitys- tai teknologiakehitysosaamista - kokemusta projektien tai kehityskokonaisuuksien johtamisesta - valmiuksia toimia tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiohankkeissa - kykyä arvioida teknologioiden vaikutuksia palveluihin, arkkitehtuureihin ja liiketoimintaan - hyviä yhteistyö-, viestintä- ja verkostoitumistaitoja - sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa kansainvälisessä yhteistyössä. **Eduksi tehtävässä ovat**- ymmärrys mobiiliverkkojen suorituskyvystä, optimoinnista ja resilienssistä - kriittisen kommunikaation ratkaisujen tuntemus - turvallisuusviranomaisten toimintaympäristön tuntemus - kokemus kansainvälisestä TKI-toiminnasta - kokemus EU tutkimus- ja kehitysohjelmista, kuten Horizon Europe-, EDF- tai EDA-hankkeista - kokemus julkisista hankinnoista - kokemus teknologioiden tuotteistamisesta tai kaupallistamisesta - tietoliikenne- tai järjestelmäarkkitehtuurien tuntemus - kyberturvallisuuden huomioiminen teknologiaratkaisuissa - kokemus paikkatietojärjestelmien käytöstä. Vaikutamme työllämme Suomen turvallisuuteen. Vaativat ja monipuoliset tehtävät ainutlaatuisen asiakaskunnan ja teknologioiden parissa vaativat vastapainokseen erityisen hyvän työpaikan. Siksi meillä huolehditaan, että Ervejoukkomme voi hyvin ja virtaa riittää myös työpäivän jälkeen. Erveläisenä voit olla ylpeä työstäsi ja osaavista työkavereistasi. Arvomme yhteistyö, luottamus, kehitys ja vastuullisuus ovat työmme perusta.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- mahdollisuuden seurata uusimpien viestintäteknologioiden kehitystä läheltä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten niitä hyödynnetään Suomessa kriittisessä viestinnässä - asiantuntevan työyhteisön, mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi sekä tehtävän, jossa teknologisilla valinnoilla on konkreettinen merkitys - työpaikan, jossa satsataan työntekijöiden hyvinvointiin; esimerkiksi vuonna 2026 erillisverkkolaiset saavat käyttää viikossa tunnin työaikaa liikuntaan - hybridityömahdollisuuden - hyvät työnteon puitteet ja mutkattoman työilmapiirin - ervenomaiset henkilöstöedut: lounasetu, virike-etu (käytettävissä myös hierontaan ja terveyspalveluihin), laaja työterveyshuolto, matkapuhelinetu ja laaja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus - mahdollisuuden tulospalkkioon - kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka sijoittuu kokemuksestasi ja osaamistaustastasi riippuen 6000–6700 €/kk välille. Tehtävässä sovelletaan ICT-alan työehtosopimusta ylemmille toimihenkilöille. **Jokainen on arvokas**. Haluamme, että työmme periaatteita kunnioittavat, erilaiset ihmiset voivat meillä kokea aidosti kuuluvansa joukkoon. Jokainen arvoihimme sitoutuva voi työskennellä turvallisuudentekijänä – iästä, kokemastaan sukupuolesta, koulutustaustasta, vakaumuksesta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta, ulkonäöstä tai muusta ominaisuudesta riippumatta.**Teemme turvallisuuskriittistä** työtä yhteistyössä viranomaisten kanssa. Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä tehdään henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (Turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Turvallisuusselvitysten tarkoitus on ennaltaehkäistä kansallista turvallisuutta vaarantavaa toimintaa. Turvallisuusselvitysmenettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja osoitteessa www.supo.fi. Lisäksi tehtävät vaativat todistuksen huumausainetestistä.

jobs.title: Sushi Chef – Full-Time Position
jobs.description:
Sushi Chef – Full-Time Position

Job Title: Sushi ChefEmployment Type: Full-time, permanent positionWork Location: Copenhagen, DenmarkWorking Hours: Full-time, approximately 37 hours per weekSalary: To be agreed based on qualifications and experienceStart Date: As soon as possible

About the Position

We are looking for a skilled and dedicated Sushi Chef to join our team at our sushi restaurant in Copenhagen.

The successful candidate will be responsible for preparing high-quality sushi and Japanese dishes while maintaining excellent food safety and hygiene standards. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Japanese cuisine, takes pride in their work, and can contribute positively to our kitchen team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and produce a variety of sushi, including nigiri, maki, uramaki, and other sushi specialties.

  • Prepare fish, seafood, rice, vegetables, and other ingredients according to established standards.

  • Ensure consistent food quality, freshness, presentation, and portion control.

  • Maintain proper food storage, temperature control, and hygiene procedures.

  • Keep the kitchen, equipment, and workstations clean and organized.

  • Monitor ingredient stock and assist with ordering and inventory management.

  • Follow Danish food safety regulations and workplace procedures.

  • Work efficiently and cooperatively with other kitchen staff.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Relevant experience in sushi preparation and Japanese cuisine is preferred.

  • Good knowledge of sushi ingredients, preparation techniques, and food hygiene.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Reliable, responsible, and detail-oriented.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced restaurant environment.

  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays when required.

We Offer

  • Full-time employment in a professional working environment.

  • Salary and employment terms based on qualifications and experience.

  • An opportunity to develop professional skills in sushi preparation and Japanese cuisine.

Application

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a brief description of their relevant work experience.

Please include your earliest possible starting date in your application.
